stories.title: Pakistan to Host 30th ECO Council of Ministers in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Pakistan is hosting the 30th Meeting of the ECO Council of Ministers in Islamabad on November 15-16, 2026. According to the Foreign Office, the event aims to enhance regional connectivity and integration under the theme "Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO." Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar will chair the conference, which features foreign ministers and delegation heads from member states, alongside representatives from the ECO secretariat and subsidiary bodies.

The ten member states of the Economic Cooperation Organization include Iran, Turkiye, Azerbaijan, Afghanistan, and five Central Asian republics. Notably, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is expected to participate amidst ongoing Middle East tensions where Pakistan and Qatar are acting as mediators for a peace deal between Iran and the United States. Furthermore, Tahsin Ertuğruloğlu, the Foreign Minister of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, has already arrived in Islamabad to attend the ministerial gathering.

The ministerial discussions are preceded by a Meeting of Senior Officials to evaluate organizational activities, review subsidiary body reports, and finalize agenda items and draft documents. Pakistan holds the ECO chairmanship for 2026-2027. Officials state that this leadership role allows Islamabad to position itself as a central regional logistics hub, a trade agenda-setter, and a facilitator for supply chains.

Ultimately, the Foreign Office noted that these collaborative initiatives strive to unlock economic potential across the region, translating cooperation into concrete benefits for the citizens of all member states. The meetings also serve to reinforce the ECO's function as an effective framework for regional dialogue, economic partnership, and sustainable development.

stories.title: Backchannel PTI-Government Talks Exclude Imran Khan and KP Regime
stories.summary:
Recent backchannel contacts between the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party and state authorities have facilitated the release of Imran Khan's two sisters after they gave commitments to avoid aggressive political activities or attacks on the military leadership. However, sources familiar with the negotiations indicate that these discussions operate within a strictly limited scope, leaving two major political issues completely off the table.

Specifically, authorities refuse to discuss any legal relief for the former prime minister, Imran Khan, or any alterations to the current political administration in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. This stance rules out any proposals aiming to reinstate Sohail Afridi as the chief minister. Sources confirmed that while family-related matters are open to dialogue, neither Khan's political standing nor the provincial governance structure will be revisited.

In contrast, the legal case and potential relief measures concerning Bushra Bibi remain open for discussion in the ongoing engagement. Officials suggested that shifting her to Banigala is a viable option under consideration. Conversely, sources categorically dismissed any possibility of transferring Imran Khan to Banigala at this stage of the negotiations.

This limited communication channel underscores a cautious approach by the authorities, who are willing to address specific family-related requests rather than negotiate broader political dispensations. The recent involvement of Imran Khan's family has temporarily eased severe tensions, yet the core political questions involving the PTI leadership and the KP government remain unchanged.

stories.title: Pakistan Envoy Emphasizes Gulf Security and Dialogue at UNSC
stories.summary:
Pakistan has reaffirmed its strong fraternal ties with Gulf nations during a UN Security Council meeting, emphasizing that the security and prosperity of the region are of immense importance to Islamabad. Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, called for an immediate halt to military provocations, unlawful attacks, and violations of state sovereignty and territorial integrity, while stressing the need to protect civilians and commercial shipping.

The ambassador explicitly condemned attacks against Gulf Cooperation Council countries, including Houthi militia threats and assaults on Saudi Arabian civilian infrastructure, airports, energy installations, and merchant vessels. He highlighted the critical role of the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, warning that maritime disruptions endanger seafarers and heighten global energy and food insecurity. Shah urged all parties to utilize diplomacy, keep communication channels open, and build a regional framework based on common security and peaceful coexistence.

This diplomatic stance aligns with recent defense initiatives between Pakistan and its regional partners. In September 2025, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed a bilateral defense agreement. Furthermore, in August 2026, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye established a trilateral security arrangement known as the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, which dictates that an attack on any member nation is considered an attack on all three.

The ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have driven Pakistan to advocate actively for de-escalation, maritime safety, and lasting stability. By supporting international initiatives and the secretary-general's good offices, Islamabad aims to foster cooperative security measures that protect vulnerable economies and restore normal passage for global commerce and humanitarian supplies.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Accelerates Groundwork for Referendum on New Provinces
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has expedited preparations to hold a referendum aimed at building consensus for the creation of new administrative provinces across the country, according to parliamentary sources. This strategic move follows strong objections from the Pakistan Peoples Party regarding proposals to establish a new province within Sindh. Consequently, upcoming sessions of both the National Assembly and the Senate have assumed critical importance.

Sources indicate that the proposed referendum could be executed under Article 48, Clause 6, which permits the Prime Minister to seek authorization for a referendum by presenting a resolution on a matter of national importance. The administration intends to complete this referendum process prior to the Senate elections anticipated in the first week of March 2027. Additionally, the government plans to approach the courts to clarify the constitutional and legal validity of the referendum.

Ongoing consultations with various stakeholders are currently underway as part of the groundwork. Current proposals suggest dividing the nation into roughly 10 to 12 new provinces. Specific ideas involve splitting Punjab into four separate entities, while dividing Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan into two provinces each. Furthermore, authorities expect the Balochistan Assembly to pass a supportive resolution backing the creation of these new administrative units.

stories.title: US Flight Operations Resume Gradually Following Major Computer Outage
stories.summary:
Domestic and international flights across the United States began resuming on Saturday after a major nationwide communications outage forced a rare four-hour groundstop. Federal Aviation Authority officials lifted the restriction, though authorities warned that returning to standard operations would take considerable time. The disruption stranded hundreds of thousands of travelers, caused nearly 6,000 flight cancellations, and filled airports nationwide with long queues and widespread confusion.

Government officials attributed the incident to outdated legacy technology rather than foul action. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy explained that the system failure stemmed from overloaded, decades-old switches, routers, and 1980s copper lines. Highlighting the vulnerability of the infrastructure, Duffy reiterated a formal congressional request for $30.1 billion to modernize the US Air Traffic Control System. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin confirmed that authorities found zero evidence pointing toward a cyberattack, artificial intelligence threat, or any connection to recent global Microsoft outages.

A nationwide groundstop of this scale is highly unusual, marking only the second instance in US airspace since the September 11 attacks, following a previous pilot notification system failure in January 2023. The incident severely impacted passenger travel plans just as the busy Thanksgiving holiday period approached. Stranded travelers faced extended delays, crowded concourses, and scrambled to find alternative travel arrangements like car rentals while awaiting updates from airline staff.

stories.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin to hold historic summit meeting in China
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold the first-ever trilateral meeting among the three leaders next week in Shenzhen, China. White House officials announced that the discussions will take place on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Trump aims to address global nuclear disarmament and discuss the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

While the meeting addresses major international issues, US officials confirmed that Russia's war in Ukraine will not be part of the agenda. Washington maintains a separate diplomatic track with Kyiv and Moscow through US envoys, excluding Beijing from those specific negotiations. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has previously expressed concern that the high-level gathering could resemble a modern adaptation of the 1945 Yalta conference, potentially dividing spheres of influence among major powers.

In addition to the trilateral talks, President Trump will participate in a bilateral working lunch and meeting with President Xi on Thursday, marking their fourth encounter since Trump assumed office last year. However, a separate one-on-one session between Trump and Putin is not planned. US representatives also noted that recent controversies involving Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang and American export controls on sensitive semiconductor technology will not be raised during the diplomatic engagements.

Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk will accompany President Trump on the journey to Asia but will not participate in the meetings with Xi and Putin. Trump is set to depart Washington on Monday, making an initial stop in the Philippines for an Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit before traveling onward to Shenzhen for the historic trilateral talks.

stories.title: Three oil tankers hit by mines in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Iran's navy and Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reported that three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the strategic Strait of Hormuz. The incidents occurred in a waterway where Tehran has restricted navigation and mandated that vessels obtain explicit authorization since hostilities with the United States began in February. Iranian forces have regularly targeted ships failing to comply with these transit restrictions.

According to the Revolutionary Guards, two of the affected vessels were traveling through unauthorized routes in the southern part of the strait with their radar and positioning systems deactivated when they detonated the mines. The conventional Iranian navy reported a third separate incident involving a tanker moving through a prohibited zone east of the waterway while its tracking and identification systems were similarly switched off. Official statements did not disclose the names or national origins of the damaged vessels, though authorities confirmed that one of the southern targets was a supertanker.

These maritime incidents unfold against the backdrop of a broader confrontation in the region. The United States has enforced a naval blockade on Iranian ports while providing military escort and support to commercial tankers utilizing the vital trade route. Iranian military branches have reported multiple explosions and fires aboard ships traversing the strait in recent weeks, frequently attributing the damage to naval mine impacts.

While the Iranian military released footage showing heavy smoke rising from a gas carrier allegedly struck by a mine in the southern corridor, the US military maintains that it has successfully cleared the primary shipping lanes of mines. The ongoing disruptions underscore the persistent dangers facing international shipping and energy transport through the critical Middle Eastern chokepoint.

stories.title: Bank of England's Pill signals further rate hikes in 2027
stories.summary:
Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill stated that the central bank will likely need to implement additional interest rate increases throughout 2027 to combat stubborn domestic inflation. Speaking in an interview published on Saturday, Pill indicated that further tightening would be necessary beyond any potential adjustments made during the upcoming December policy meeting to ensure inflation returns to the target rate over time.

The central bank previously raised interest rates from 3.75% to 4% in November, marking the first increase since August 2023. While Pill described that adjustment as a significant step toward stabilizing monetary policy, he emphasized that additional measures are required due to persistent risks stemming from elevated energy costs and wage pressures. British inflation is currently projected to reach approximately 5% by the middle of next year, more than double the bank's official 2% target.

Pill attributed much of the inflationary pressure to second-round effects on wages driven by the ongoing conflict involving Iran. He noted that a de-escalation of the US-Israeli conflict with Iran and a subsequent drop in energy prices remain highly unlikely, signaling his inclination to support another quarter-point rate increase next month. Furthermore, Pill expressed regret that the central bank did not act more aggressively at an earlier stage, noting that delays in raising borrowing costs have reduced the ability to implement modest policy adjustments.

Financial markets currently anticipate roughly 90 basis points of monetary tightening by the end of 2027, which could push interest rates close to 5%. Pill remarked that these market expectations are reasonable given the economic outlook. Additionally, Pill announced that he does not intend to seek a third term as the institution's chief economist when his current contract concludes in September 2027.

stories.title: امریکہ میں مواصلاتی خرابی کے بعد فضائی آپریشن بحال، پروازیں معطل رہیں
stories.summary:
امریکہ بھر میں ہوائی ٹریفک کنٹرول کے مواصلاتی نظام میں تکنیکی خرابی کے باعث نافذ ہونے والی عارضی پابندی کے بعد فضائی آپریشن دوبارہ بحال کر دیا گیا ہے۔ یہ غیر معمولی گراؤنڈ سٹاپ چار گھنٹے سے زائد جاری رہا جس سے ملک بھر کے ہوائی اڈوں پر شدید خلل پیدا ہوا اور لاکھوں مسافر متاثر ہوئے۔ 11 ستمبر 2001 کے حملوں کے بعد یہ پہلا موقع تھا کہ امریکی فضائی نظام میں اتنے بڑے پیمانے پر تعطل دیکھا گیا۔

وائٹ ہاؤس میں پریس بریفنگ کے دوران امریکی وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ شان ڈفی اور ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کے سیکریٹری مارک وین مولن نے بتایا کہ زمینی پروازوں پر عائد پابندی امریکی وقت کے مطابق رات سوا آٹھ بجے ختم کر دی گئی۔ حکام نے واضح کیا کہ اس واقعے کے پیچھے کسی قسم کے سائبر حملے کا کوئی ثبوت نہیں ملا اور یہ محض ایک ٹیلی کمیونی کیشن کا تعطل تھا۔

وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ نے اس بات پر روشنی ڈ डाली کہ یہ خرابی پرانے اور فرسودہ آلات میں پیدا ہوئی جو فضائی ٹریفک کنٹرول کے نظام سے متعلق تھے۔ انہوں نے خبردار کیا کہ اگر اس نقل و حمل کے نظام کی مکمل از سرِ نو تعمیر نہ کی گئی اور اسے جدید نہ بنایا گیا تو ایسے واقعات دوبارہ پیش آ سکتے ہیں۔

امریکہ کے فیڈرل ایوی ایشن ایڈمنسٹریشن (ایف اے اے) نے نظام کو مکمل طور پر جانچنے کے بعد پروازیں دوبارہ شروع کرنے کی اجازت دی۔ تاہم، حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ پروازوں کی معطلی کے فوری اثرات ختم نہیں ہوں گے اور نظام کو مکمل معمول پر آنے میں چند روز کا وقت لگ سکتا ہے۔ مختلف ایئر لائنز بشمول امریکن ایئر لائنز، ڈیلٹا اور جیٹ بلیو نے بھی اپنی پروازیں محفوظ طریقے سے بحال کرنا شروع کر دی ہیں۔

stories.title: Police defeat terrorist assault on Bannu checkpost, killing four
stories.summary:
Security forces successfully repelled a late-night terrorist assault on the Kingar Pul Police Checkpost in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Bannu district on Friday. According to local police authorities, heavily armed militants initiated a sudden raid on the installation under the cover of darkness. Stationed police personnel mounted an immediate and effective defense, successfully holding off the attackers.

Following the initial exchange, reinforcements from Police Lines, including the Rapid Response Force, were immediately dispatched to the location. Law enforcement units established a complete cordon around the area and initiated an extensive clearance and search operation. Authorities confirmed that the bodies of four slain terrorists were recovered during the follow-up sweep of the surrounding terrain.

During the operation, police secured a substantial cache of weaponry and military equipment left behind by the attackers. Seized items included four Kalashnikov rifles, multiple ammunition magazines, hand grenades, bandoliers, and a significant quantity of loose ammunition. Officials stated that formal identification procedures for the neutralized attackers are currently underway to determine their affiliations.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Inspector General of Police Zulfiqar Hameed formally commended the Bannu police force for their bravery, professional training, and vigilance during the nocturnal engagement. The provincial police chief reiterated that comprehensive strategies and ongoing counter-terrorism operations remain fully active across the region. Safeguarding the lives and property of local citizens continues to be the primary objective for law enforcement agencies amid a broader surge in militant activity across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

stories.title: Wasim Akram Doubts Pat Cummins' Claim on 2018 Sandpaper Scandal
stories.summary:
Pakistan fast-bowling legend Wasim Akram has publicly questioned Australia captain Pat Cummins' assertion that he was unaware of sandpaper usage during the notorious 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa. Speaking from Melbourne on Saturday, Wasim argued that any seasoned bowler would immediately notice the distinction between normal wear on a cricket ball and deliberate physical damage. He explained that marks caused by sandpaper are completely different from those resulting from standard contact with the ground.

The controversy recently resurfaced following claims in former Australia opener Usman Khawaja's autobiography, Sabr. Khawaja alleged that awareness of the tampering plot was widespread throughout the Australian dressing room, including among the bowling group during the Newlands tour. During the third Test in Cape Town, Cameron Bancroft was caught on camera using sandpaper to alter the ball. Subsequent disciplinary measures saw Bancroft, then-captain Steve Smith, and vice-captain David Warner receive suspensions.

Cummins firmly rejected Khawaja's allegations during a press conference in Sydney, labeling them entirely false and expressing genuine surprise at Khawaja's assertions. Despite Cummins' denials, Wasim stated that the enduring scandal continues to cast a shadow over the Australian team's reputation for honesty and sportsmanship. Cricket Australia has confirmed it will not reopen its investigation into the historic event.

Wasim emphasized that he considers Cummins a close friend and was not trying to take sides in the ongoing dispute. However, his remarks add significant weight to a debate that continues to divide opinions on player knowledge regarding the incident. More than eight years later, the renewed controversy keeps the Australian team's conduct under intense public and media scrutiny.

stories.title: Peshawar Police Neutralize Four Terrorists in Check Post Raid
stories.summary:
Peshawar police successfully repulsed a terrorist attack on a security check post at the Bannu Kangar bridge, resulting in the deaths of four attackers belonging to Fitna al-Khawarij. According to the City Police Officer, law enforcement officers acted swiftly during the late-night assault, recovering various weapons and ammunition from the slain insurgents. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Inspector General praised the valor of the local police force, declaring that terrorist elements have no place on the soil of KP and vowing to ensure their complete eradication.

This incident coincides with a broader counterterrorism campaign across Pakistan. The Inter-Services Public Relations reported that security forces killed 74 individuals linked to the Indian-sponsored Fitna-al-Khawarij and Fitna-al-Hindustan during intelligence-based operations in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Operations in the Kurram area of Quetta district, ongoing since November 3, neutralized 31 militants. Simultaneously, expanded operations in Mir Ali and Orakzai eliminated 35 and 8 terrorists respectively over a 48-hour period.

During these extensive sanitisation operations, security forces recovered large caches of arms, ammunition, and explosives, including homemade devices and IEDs. The military's media wing stated that these actions successfully thwarted plots to utilize the materials in destructive attacks. Officials reiterated that these comprehensive operations are being executed under the Azm-e-Istehkam vision and the National Action Plan.

Law enforcement and military agencies remain firmly committed to purging foreign-backed terrorism from the country. The ongoing intelligence-led missions seek to dismantle active militant networks and secure vulnerable regions, reflecting the state's resolve to protect citizens and maintain national stability against persistent security threats.

stories.title: Provinces Receive Rs1,895 Billion Under NFC Award in First Quarter
stories.summary:
Pakistan's four provinces collected a combined total of Rs1,895 billion from the federal divisible tax pool during the first quarter of the 2026-27 fiscal year, according to Ministry of Finance documents. Punjab received the highest allocation at Rs942 billion, recording revenues of Rs1,117 billion against expenditures of Rs784 billion to achieve a Rs333 billion surplus. Sindh obtained Rs479 billion, posting revenues of Rs690 billion and expenditures of Rs509 billion for a surplus of Rs180 billion.

Meanwhile, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa received Rs314 billion, generating total revenues of Rs413 billion and spending Rs311 billion to leave a budget surplus of Rs102 billion. Balochistan received Rs158 billion during the July-September period; however, its revenues of Rs175 billion fell short of its expenditures of Rs191 billion, resulting in a budget deficit of Rs16 billion. Fund distributions are regulated by the National Finance Commission Award, allocating 57.5 percent of net proceeds from major federal taxes to provinces based on population, poverty, revenue generation, and inverse population density.

Separately, the federal government's Fiscal Operations Report for the same quarter revealed total federal revenues of Rs6,003 billion against total expenditures of Rs4,370 billion. Major federal spending included Rs1,700 billion for public debt interest payments, Rs495 billion for defense, Rs263 billion for pensions, Rs206 billion for civil government operations, and Rs84 billion for subsidies. Additionally, the State Bank of Pakistan posted a profit of Rs1,932 billion during the opening quarter of the fiscal year.

stories.title: Asia Pacific's Aging Population Faces Rising Chronic Disease Crisis
stories.summary:
Health experts meeting at the Silver Economy Forum 2026 in Kuala Lumpur warned that the Asia Pacific region's rapidly aging population faces a mounting chronic disease crisis. With nearly 1.3 billion people expected to be over the age of 60 by 2050, specialists emphasize that extended lifespans must be accompanied by proactive healthcare models focusing on prevention, early diagnosis, and sustainable treatment rather than reactive interventions.

The urgency is underscored by alarming statistics regarding cardiovascular issues and strokes. In 2020, Asia accounted for 61 percent of global stroke deaths, translating to roughly 4.1 million lives lost, a proportion that could climb to 69 percent, or 6.6 million deaths annually, by 2050. Globally, research published in The Lancet Public Health in July 2026 shows individuals now spend an average of 10.7 years in poor health, up from 8.8 years in 1990. In the Asia Pacific region, individuals reaching age 60 spend nearly five remaining years dealing with disease and disability.

Conditions like heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and cancer account for nearly nine out of ten deaths in the Western Pacific Region. In Malaysia, approximately one in three adults suffers from high cholesterol, and 40 percent of stroke patients are under the age of 60. Beyond human suffering, the economic toll is immense; stroke alone costs the global economy over $890 billion annually, projected to reach $2.31 trillion by 2050. In Malaysia, non-communicable diseases cost the economy RM64.2 billion annually, with roughly 80 percent stemming from lost productivity.

To counter these challenges, experts and industry leaders from organizations like Bayer and the Global Coalition on Ageing advocate for systemic policy reforms. They call for enhanced routine health checks from midlife, closer cooperation between health and finance ministries, and the creation of age-inclusive cities, workplaces, and care economies that support lifelong health and economic participation.

stories.title: US Air Force Responds to Drone Activity Over British Military Base
stories.summary:
United States military forces responded to suspected drone activity over a facility in Britain on Friday, according to an Air Force spokesperson. The security incident took place at the RAF Lakenheath base, which hosts American military aircraft. The Air Force spokesperson confirmed in a statement that no personnel, aircraft, or infrastructure were harmed during the event, and authorities continue to coordinate with local host nation counterparts to guarantee the safety of service members, civilians, and families.

This security scare follows recent legal actions by the United States Justice Department, which announced charges earlier in the week against three individuals identified as Iranian operatives. These suspects are accused of involvement in a separate terrorist plot targeting RAF Fairford, another British installation. That incident in September came to light after a local farmer reported suspicious activity involving a group of men and white vans near the facility.

According to US charging documents, a man named Mohammad Ali al-Hassani allegedly directed individuals to drive fuel-filled vans to the base and paid them to purchase metallic shrapnel objects. In response to heightened security threats, the United States withdrew all B-1 bombers from the base days after the September incident. American military aircraft have utilized British bases to support operations tied to the US-Israeli conflict against Iran earlier in the year.

The broader regional tensions were further underscored when Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei warned in a broadcast interview that Iran could strike US bases outside the Middle East, including in Europe, if they are leveraged for attacks against the Islamic Republic. Security remains heightened across facilities hosting American assets abroad.

stories.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin to Hold First Trilateral Meeting in China
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping will convene for the first-ever three-way meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia, and China. White House officials announced on Friday that the historic trilateral summit will take place next week in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

White House spokeswoman Olivia Wales stated that President Trump intends to focus discussions on reducing global nuclear arsenals, a form of proliferation he views as extremely dangerous. Senior US officials added that Trump also plans to address the war in Iran during the meeting. However, they clarified that Russia's war in Ukraine will not be part of the agenda, as Washington handles those discussions through a separate diplomatic track involving Kyiv and Moscow that does not include China.

Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk will accompany Trump on the trip to China but will not participate in the trilateral discussions with Xi and Putin. In addition to the three-way talks, Trump is scheduled to hold a separate bilateral working lunch and meeting with President Xi on Thursday, marking their fourth encounter since Trump returned to power last year. Trump does not have a one-on-one meeting scheduled with Putin.

US officials noted that several other high-profile issues will not be raised during the visit, including the recent resignation of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, as well as American export controls on sensitive chip technology. Trump is set to depart Washington on Monday, stop in the Philippines on Tuesday for an ASEAN summit, and then travel onward to Shenzhen.

stories.title: ماہرین فلکیات نے زمین کے ایک نئے عارضی منی مون کی دریافت کا اعلان کر دیا
stories.summary:
ماہرینِ فلکیات نے انکشاف کیا ہے کہ زمین کو ایک نیا عارضی منی مون مل گیا ہے۔ اس چھوٹے سیارچے کا نام 2026 QQ8 ہے، جسے سب سے پہلے اگست میں ہنگری کے ماہرِ فلکیات کرسٹیان سارنیژکی نے دیکھا تھا، اور بعد میں بین الاقوامی فلکیاتی یونین کے مائنر پلینیٹ سینٹر نے اس کی اطلاع جاری کی۔

یہ ایک انتہائی چھوٹی خلائی چٹان ہے جس کا قطر ایک سے دو میٹر کے درمیان ہے۔ یہ زمین سے پانچ لاکھ کلومیٹر سے زائد فاصلے پر موجود ہے جو کہ ہمارے اصل چاند سے بھی کہیں زیادہ دور ہے۔ ماہرین کے مطابق یہ سیارچہ اپریل میں زمین کی کششِ ثقل کے دائرے میں آیا تھا اور توقع ہے کہ آئندہ چند ماہ میں یہ دوبارہ آزاد ہو جائے گا۔

ڈاکٹر جینیفر ملارڈ کے مطابق اس طرح کے نیم سیاروی چاند ہمارے اصل چاند کی طرح زمین کے گرد نہیں گھومتے بلکہ صرف ہمارے قریب رہتے ہیں۔ ایسے عارضی خلائی اجسام زمین کے لیے کوئی خطرہ نہیں بنتے کیونکہ یہ ہمیشہ چاند کے مقابلے میں بہت زیادہ فاصلے پر رہتے ہیں اور ان کی رفتار بھی سست ہوتی ہے۔

حال ہی میں دوربین اور کمپیوٹر ٹیکنالوجی میں نمایاں پیش رفت ہوئی ہے، جس کی بدولت ان مدھم اور مشکل سے نظر آنے والے سیارچوں کا سراغ لگانا ممکن ہو سکا ہے۔ اب تک مشتری، زہرہ، زحل، نیپچون اور پلوٹو کے قریب بھی ایسے نیم چاند دیکھے جا چکے ہیں، جو اس بات کی غمازی کرتے ہیں کہ ہمارا شمسی نظام ایک مسلسل متحرک جگہ ہے۔

stories.title: Massive FAA Ground Stop Disrupts Travel for Tens of Thousands
stories.summary:
A nationwide ground stop issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) triggered major travel chaos across the United States on Friday, marking the largest halt to domestic air travel since the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. The stoppage lasted for four hours, resulting in the cancellation of over 6,600 flights and delays for another 8,600, according to data from FlightRadar24. It represents only the third nationwide ground stop ordered by the FAA this century.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy attributed the widespread disruptions not to malicious actors, but to a failure of aging network technology within the radar and communications infrastructure utilized for air traffic control. Airports across the country experienced severe congestion, with information display boards overwhelmed by delayed and canceled flights. Stranded passengers expressed frustration over the lack of clear duration estimates, while others voiced anxiety reminiscent of past aviation security crises.

Fliers shared varying experiences of the disruption, ranging from missed family reunions and rebooked weekend itineraries to being stuck on crowded airport runways for hours. Some travelers, like 71-year-old former Air Force member Debra Bliesner, viewed the FAA's drastic stoppage as a necessary safety precaution despite the personal inconvenience. Others, such as Edward Karagbo, found themselves stranded overnight at major terminals like Newark Liberty International Airport waiting for rerouted departures.

Even after the FAA officially lifted the ground stop, the ripple effects left tens of thousands of travelers stranded at airports, with many facing overnight delays. Transportation officials indicated that clearing the massive backlog and restoring normal scheduling operations would take extended time, leaving the nation's air travel network under intense scrutiny.

stories.title: Trump Not Expected to Discuss Alice Huang Case With Xi at APEC
stories.summary:
United States officials announced on Friday that President Donald Trump will not raise the Alice Huang case during his upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The two leaders are scheduled to meet next week on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, China, as part of a four-day Asian trip.

The controversy involves businesswoman Alice Huang, whose connections to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang sparked national security concerns regarding alleged spying for China. Just days before the trip, Jensen Huang resigned from his position at Nvidia, capping a sudden departure from the chip industry after independent members of Nvidia's board hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate his relationship with the businesswoman.

While semiconductors remain a significant flashpoint in bilateral relations, a senior administration official stated that Washington will not brief Chinese leadership on ongoing domestic investigations at this time. A second official confirmed that the president is not expected to bring up the issue.

Neither Alice Huang nor her current whereabouts have been officially reached for comment. Reuters has not independently verified her alleged activities, and the US Department of Justice has stated that no official conclusions have been reached regarding any affiliation with the Chinese government.

Jensen Huang released a statement apologizing for personal infidelity and disappointing the company, though he did not specifically mention Alice Huang, a former executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed International.

stories.title: Mirra Andreeva learns to handle defeats better after reaching WTA Finals
stories.summary:
Nineteen-year-old tennis player Mirra Andreeva stated that she has learned to recover more swiftly from losses after completing an undefeated round-robin stage at the WTA Finals. The Russian teenager secured her spot in the semi-finals after winning her third group-stage match in straight sets against tournament alternate Diana Shnaider following a late opponent change.

Reflecting on her progress, Andreeva contrasted her current mindset with her dramatic reactions to past defeats. Earlier in the season at Indian Wells, where she was defending her title, she experienced a frustrating loss to Katerina Siniakova and lashed out with a profanity-laced tirade at spectators. She noted that previously, a loss would result in her locking herself in a room for two or three days without talking to anyone or practicing.

Now, Andreeva explained that disappointment typically lasts for a maximum of one day before the demands of the tennis tour push her back into training and preparation. She attributed this positive mental shift to continued work on the court, psychological sessions, and adjusting her gameplay. 

This improved emotional control has coincided with strong career milestones. Andreeva captured her first Grand Slam title at Roland Garros earlier in the year and entered the WTA Finals for her singles debut following a 50-win season. Her victory in the desert set up her first career match against American Jessica Pegula in the semi-finals.

stories.title: US Senators Demand Elon Musk Preserve SpaceX Records on Ukraine Starlink
stories.summary:
Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire and Chris Coons of Delaware have officially ordered Elon Musk to preserve all records pertaining to SpaceX's restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield satellite communication services. Ukrainian forces rely heavily on Starshield, the military-grade version of Starlink, for essential frontline communications and drone operations in their ongoing defense against Russian attacks.

In mid-October, Ukrainian officials reported that the service had been restricted without warning or explanation. This disruption limited the military's capability to execute complex strike missions against Russian forces and slowed the interceptor drones used to neutralize incoming attacks. The senators warned that these restrictions expose disturbing vulnerabilities within systems that are also utilized by the US government.

The lawmakers directed Musk to provide written confirmation by November 30 ensuring that all appropriate preservation measures have been implemented. Furthermore, they requested SpaceX records dating back to September 1, which include all communications regarding Starlink and Starshield in Ukraine, as well as correspondence between Musk, SpaceX executives, the White House, and the Pentagon.

The situation has sparked conflicting accounts among officials. While Reuters reported that an order to limit the Starshield service originated inside the White House, Secretary of State Marco Rubio disputed this claim, stating that access decisions rested solely with SpaceX and Musk. Although Ukrainian officials later stated the systems were operating normally, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy reported fresh disruptions to Starshield communications.

stories.title: Lahore Bus Conductor Fired After Mistreating Female Passenger
stories.summary:
A bus conductor on a Lahore Green Electric Bus was dismissed from his job following an incident where he allegedly misbehaved with a female passenger and pushed her off the vehicle. The event gained widespread attention after a video of the conductor's actions circulated on social media, prompting public outrage and immediate calls for accountability from citizens.

Punjab Transport and Mass Transit Minister Bilal Akbar Khan intervened, ordering swift disciplinary action against the employee. Following an internal review, the Lahore BRT management determined that the conductor, identified as Ali Rizwan, violated passenger-handling standards and the corporate code of conduct, leading to the termination of his employment.

However, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif deemed job dismissal insufficient and directed the police to arrest the conductor and ensure he issued a public apology. The chief minister instructed authorities to bring Rizwan directly to the affected woman's residence so he could apologize in front of the public and face DIG Faisal Kamran's directed actions.

In a video shared by the chief minister on social media, Ali Rizwan expressed deep regret and shame regarding his behavior. He apologized directly to the victim and the entire nation, promising never to treat anyone in such a manner again.

stories.title: Elina Svitolina Prioritizes Daughter and Co-Parenting After Gael Monfils Split
stories.summary:
Tennis player Elina Svitolina shared that maintaining a strong co-parenting dynamic with Gael Monfils and safeguarding their daughter's wellbeing are her main priorities following their separation. The Ukrainian athlete and Monfils, a French former world number six, announced their split last month after marrying in July 2021 and welcoming their daughter, Skai, in October 2022. Svitolina noted that the pressures stemming from Russia's war in Ukraine contributed to the breakdown of their marriage.

Despite the breakup, Svitolina stated that she and Monfils remain in regular, positive contact, speaking even shortly before her matches. Her recent victory over Aryna Sabalenka at the WTA Finals round-robin advanced her to the semi-finals at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden, where she is set to face Linda Noskova for a spot in the final of the $10 million tournament, which was relocated from Riyadh.

Svitolina acknowledged that the tournament offered no escape from public attention regarding her personal life. She described how intense public scrutiny and hostile social media comments added to an already challenging period, prompting her to occasionally disconnect from applications like Instagram to focus entirely on her family.

Having dealt with years of public visibility, Svitolina has developed personal resilience against online abuse, though she admitted it can leave athletes feeling vulnerable. She expressed support for ongoing efforts by the WTA to enhance player protection through heightened security measures and active measures against online harassment.

stories.title: NADRA Outlines Online Account Recovery Steps for Pak ID App
stories.summary:
The National Database and Registration Authority has released instructions for citizens attempting to recover existing Pak ID accounts when encountering registration errors. Officials explained that users seeing notification messages indicating their CNIC numbers are already linked to alternate accounts should initiate account recovery procedures rather than creating duplicate profiles.

To begin the recovery process, individuals must open the mobile application and input their CNIC numbers on the primary login screen before selecting the designated password recovery option. Users are then required to supply registered email addresses to receive two-factor authentication codes. Following code validation, account holders must complete mandatory biometric verification procedures to verify personal identity before regaining full access.

The application provides citizens with digital access to essential national identity services, including card renewals, modifications, replacements, and related documentation requests. Individuals experiencing persistent technical difficulties during login or registration procedures can contact the dedicated helpline at 1777.

In separate regional developments, law enforcement personnel in Peshawar successfully neutralized a militant assault targeting a police checkpoint situated near the Bannu Kangar bridge. Local police leadership confirmed that four attackers were killed during the operation, while security forces recovered multiple weapons and ammunition supplies from the possession of the slain individuals.

stories.title: Trump Administration Seeks $50 Billion for Air Traffic Modernization
stories.summary:
The Trump administration has escalated its funding request for national air traffic control to $50 billion following a major technological outage that forced a nationwide groundstop and disrupted thousands of flights. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and White House budget director Russell Vought initially requested $30.1 billion before expanding the proposal, describing the system upgrades as an urgent national emergency.

The communication failure severely impacted Federal Aviation Administration en route centers responsible for managing aircraft traffic between airports. The expanded financial package designates $10.1 billion specifically for modernization efforts, which includes $7.2 billion allocated for common automation platforms and controller workstations alongside $2 billion dedicated to cloud computing infrastructure. Furthermore, the proposal contains $2 billion directed toward replacing and improving air traffic control towers and $18 billion intended for airport-related developments, including terminal modernizations.

Lawmakers have previously approved $12.5 billion over a five-year period in July 2025 to increase controller hiring and address technology bottlenecks within the country's airspace, which has recently faced serious safety incidents. The agency continues to rely on decades-old computer systems, including floppy disks scheduled for replacement by late 2028. Major commercial carriers have expressed support for the administration's funding appeal as officials urge Congress to approve the financial package before the end of the year.

The system vulnerabilities have caused recurring disruptions across the United States. In September, dual circuit failures and a severed fiber-optic cable in New Jersey led to widespread delays and cancellations throughout the Northeast region.

stories.title: Pakistan to Host Thirtieth ECO Council of Ministers Meeting
stories.summary:
Pakistan will host the 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organization Council of Ministers in Islamabad on November 15 and 16. The Foreign Office announced that Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar will chair the high-level gathering, which will welcome foreign ministers, delegation heads, and representatives from member states, the organization secretariat, and subsidiary bodies.

Prior to the ministerial sessions, senior officials from member nations will convene to review ongoing institutional programs, evaluate subsidiary activities, and finalize the official agenda and draft documents. Operating under the theme 'Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO,' Pakistan holds the organizational chairmanship for the 2026-27 term. The nation aims to utilize its leadership role to enhance regional connectivity, deepen economic partnerships, and establish itself as a primary logistics and trade hub.

Preparations for the upcoming summit follow previous high-level engagements, including the 17th ECO Summit held in Azerbaijan in July 2025, where Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif led the Pakistani delegation. During those discussions, leadership emphasized expanded intra-regional trade, energy cooperation, and sustainable transport networks aligned with long-term regional objectives.

Authorities have stressed the importance of seamless coordination to ensure the success of the Islamabad conference. The diplomatic forum is expected to address critical regional trade dynamics and foster closer economic collaboration to improve the livelihoods of citizens across member countries.

stories.title: Pakistan and Ethiopia Discuss WTO Accession and Bilateral Trade
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan and Ethiopia’s Minister of Trade and Regional Integration, Yasmin Wohabrebbi, conducted a virtual high-level meeting to advance bilateral economic ties. Discussions centered on expanding commercial cooperation, supporting Ethiopia's accession to the World Trade Organization, and resolving outstanding market access and pharmaceutical regulatory challenges.

During the talks, Jam Kamal emphasized Pakistan's dedication to strengthening economic partnerships, positioning Ethiopia as a vital gateway into East African markets. He highlighted potential areas for collaboration including agriculture, textiles, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, while calling for expedited resolutions regarding regulatory hurdles and direct air connectivity. Minister Wohabrebbi acknowledged Pakistan's constructive engagement and reported that 11 out of 17 bilateral market-access agreements have been finalized, requesting continued support to complete the remaining accession requirements.

Commerce Secretary Jawad Paul joined the discussions, stressing the necessity of ongoing technical coordination between relevant institutions to clear pending pharmaceutical registrations and eliminate trade bottlenecks. Both governments outlined plans to enhance institutional cooperation by convening the Joint Economic Committee and developing a strategic roadmap prior to a proposed bilateral engagement scheduled for February 2027.

Concluding the session, Jam Kamal reaffirmed that prompt implementation and decisive actions will help realize the untapped commercial potential between both nations, transforming diplomatic goodwill into practical economic outcomes.

stories.title: South Korean Foreign Minister Urges Deeper Ties and Balanced Cooperation With China
stories.summary:
South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated that Seoul should neither harbor an unfounded fear of China's rise nor underestimate its capabilities. Speaking on Saturday following his discussions in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, Cho emphasized the importance of fostering mutually beneficial cooperation. This dialogue marked the first meeting between the two diplomats in approximately three months, during which they reviewed bilateral relations, peninsula issues, and ways to deliver tangible benefits to their respective populations.

The diplomatic engagement precedes the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders' summit in Shenzhen, scheduled for November 18-19. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung is set to participate in the gathering and will attend a dinner hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping alongside his wife. The regional summit is expected to convene multiple prominent global figures, including U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin, who are slated to discuss nuclear arms reductions.

Cho indicated that Seoul aims to leverage President Lee's upcoming journey to strengthen bilateral connections and expand horizontal, mutually beneficial partnerships in complementary sectors. Under President Lee, the administration has worked to repair diplomatic ties with Beijing—South Korea's primary trading partner—following strains experienced during the tenure of former president Yoon Suk Yeol, while simultaneously preserving its security alliance with the United States.

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi noted that relations have returned to appropriate pathways following interactions between leadership figures. He expressed Beijing's desire to broaden cooperation with South Korea across both traditional industries and emerging fields such as artificial intelligence and biomedicine. These diplomatic efforts highlight a concerted push by both nations to stabilize and enhance their bilateral partnership ahead of the high-stakes leaders' summit.

stories.title: Free WordPress Plugin Reprint Enables Complete Site Transfers and Testing
stories.summary:
Website administrators running WordPress now have access to a complimentary open-source utility named Reprint, designed to duplicate entire site files and databases directly onto a separate server or a personal computer. Built with PHP, the software and its command-line companion are available inside the official WordPress.org Plugin Directory. Because data moves straight to the target hardware without intermediaries, users retain complete control over the migration process.

Unlike traditional export utilities focused exclusively on individual posts or pages, Reprint duplicates an entire installation, encompassing themes, uploaded media, active plugins, and specific configuration settings. Data packets transfer in incremental segments so the original hosting environment does not require surplus storage capacity beforehand. Furthermore, paused or interrupted transfers resume automatically from the exact point of interruption instead of starting over from the beginning.

While the target copy undergoes review, the original webpage remains online and accessible to visitors. WordPress recommends verifying image rendering, form functionality, and page load speeds prior to redirecting domain traffic. Administrators can then halt fresh updates on the legacy server, perform one final synchronization, and update their domain pointers. The utility also automatically updates uniform resource locators embedded within shortcodes, custom data fields, serialized information, and content blocks.

Beyond server migrations, the software facilitates local environment testing, layout experimentation, and post-update validation. For quick evaluations, a specialized feature inside WordPress Playground permits browser-based sample duplication without manual installations. Concurrently, developers note that this rollout coincides with the deployment of WordPress 7.2 Beta 5, which authorities strictly advise limiting to designated test environments rather than production websites.

stories.title: US Aviation System Suffers Massive Breakdown Sparking Nationwide Ground Stop
stories.summary:
A major technical malfunction crippled aviation networks across the United States, forcing the Federal Aviation Administration to order an unprecedented nationwide ground stop. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that air traffic control facilities experienced severe radar and communications instability due to data routers and switches becoming critically overloaded. Although officials managed to safely guide airborne aircraft to their destinations without completely losing contact, the disruption caused the longest aviation shutdown since the attacks of September 11, 2001.

Transportation leadership announced that airspace officially reopened during the evening hours, though departures resumed at a restricted pace. Flight tracking data from FlightRadar24 revealed that more than 6,600 flights suffered cancellations, another 8,600 faced significant delays, and thousands of additional trips scheduled for subsequent days were preemptively grounded. Major airlines including American, United, Delta, and JetBlue experienced immediate financial impacts, with stock values declining in after-hours trading. Airports nationwide saw massive crowds of passengers stranded in departure halls overnight, while carriers attempted to reposition aircraft crews and prioritize flights to international destinations and smaller cities.

Government officials emphasized that the disruption originated from mechanical issues rather than external cyber threats or artificial intelligence malfunctions, though comprehensive investigations involving the National Security Agency and the Department of Homeland Security remain ongoing. Industry insiders indicated the failure impacted critical telecommunications infrastructure managed by L3Harris Technologies that handles essential pilot-controller radio frequencies. Because the outage stemmed from government system failures rather than airline negligence, carriers are not legally obligated to compensate affected travelers.

Highlighting the incident, Secretary Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin briefed President Donald Trump on the escalating crisis. Officials pointed to an aging aviation infrastructure plagued by outdated technology and severe controller shortages as the root cause of the breakdown. The administration renewed urgent appeals to Congress for multi-billion-dollar investments to modernize the country's outdated air traffic control architecture and prevent future national disruptions.

stories.title: Iranian Revolutionary Guards Report Two Oil Tankers Hit by Strait of Hormuz Mines
stories.summary:
Iranian military authorities announced that explosions rocked two separate oil tankers after striking naval mines inside the Strait of Hormuz. According to statements released by the naval branch of Iran's Revolutionary Guards, the vessels had deactivated their radar and positioning equipment while attempting to navigate through unauthorized passages. The naval command confirmed that the blasts resulted in substantial fires, though specific vessel names and nationalities were withheld, aside from noting that one of the damaged ships classified as a supertanker.

Tensions in the crucial waterway have escalated significantly following the outbreak of armed conflict with the United States. Tehran has asserted strict control over the strategic trade route, mandating prior authorization for all passing ships and launching attacks against vessels that fail to comply. In response to these actions, the United States enforced a naval blockade surrounding Iranian ports while supplying military escorts to commercial tankers traversing the zone.

Recent weeks have witnessed multiple reported blasts and fires aboard commercial ships navigating the strait, with Iranian state media routinely attributing the incidents to naval mine impacts. Footage released by the Revolutionary Guards depicted heavy black smoke billowing from a gas-carrying vessel allegedly struck by a mine near the southern portion of the corridor. Conversely, United States military officials maintain that primary shipping channels throughout the waterway have been successfully swept and cleared of explosive mines.

stories.title: India Recalls Fast Bowler Brar and Clears Pant for New Zealand Test Series
stories.summary:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced official roster adjustments ahead of the upcoming two-test series against New Zealand, introducing fast bowler Gurnoor Brar to the national setup. The 26-year-old athlete will travel directly to join the test squad, meaning he will miss the final one-day international match taking place in Tauranga. Selectors decided not to name an immediate replacement for Brar, as the visiting Indian team maintains a 2-1 lead in the ongoing five-match one-day series.

Concurrently, left-arm wrist spinner Kuldeep Yadav was released from the test setup to participate in domestic cricket matches within India. Meanwhile, wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant rejoined the national team group in Wellington after successfully obtaining medical clearance regarding his physical fitness. The opening match of the two-test encounter is scheduled to commence on November 19.

The finalized test roster features Shubman Gill as captain alongside Yashasvi Jaiswal, KL Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, Rishabh Pant, Dhruv Jurel, Ravindra Jadeja, Anshul Kamboj, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Sai Sudharsan, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, Mohammed Siraj, and newly added Gurnoor Brar.

Separately, the squad assembled for the final one-day fixture comprises Shreyas Iyer leading Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Tilak Varma, Ishan Kishan, Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Kumar Kushagra, Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur, and Kuldeep Yadav.

stories.title: Pakistan Urges Gulf De-escalation Amid US-Iran UN Security Council Clash
stories.summary:
Pakistan called for an immediate halt to military provocations in the Gulf and renewed regional diplomacy during a United Nations Security Council meeting on November 12, 2026. Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, condemned attacks on Gulf countries, commercial shipping, and civilian infrastructure, while warning that threats to maritime navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandab Strait endanger seafarers and worsen global energy and food insecurity. He also reaffirmed support for Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and security.

The debate featured sharply conflicting accusations between the United States and Iran over responsibility for maritime security threats. Iranian Ambassador Gholamhossein Darzi blamed unprovoked wars launched by the US and Israel on June 13, 2025, and February 28, 2026, for regional insecurity, citing 5,000 deaths in Iran and rejecting Security Council Resolution 2817. He asserted that foreign military forces are a major source of instability.

Conversely, US Ambassador Jennifer Locetta accused Iran of aggression against neighbors, firing on commercial ships, and defying the international community with missiles, drones, and unlawful mines. She cited Resolution 2817, which had 136 co-sponsors and demanded that Iran halt attacks, and criticized the Houthis for targeting Saudi infrastructure and blockading the Bab el-Mandab Strait.

Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi reported that GCC member states had faced over 7,000 Iranian missiles and drones since February 28, targeting vital infrastructure and causing casualties and environmental damage. Bahrain’s Ambassador Jamal Fares Alrowaiei welcomed mediation efforts by Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan, emphasizing that regional security requires the active participation of GCC states.

stories.title: Speedrun AI Labs Launches Free Tool to Reverse Engineer Software
stories.summary:
Sydney-based startup Speedrun AI Labs has released a free, open-source tool under an MIT license named Reverse Engineer Anything with a Self-Learning Loop. The software is designed to solve a frequent problem in automated software development, where AI agents rebuilding authorized products stall at around 80 percent completion due to a lack of clear final product requirements.

The tool establishes a structured workflow for the final 20 percent of a software rebuild. Prior to coding, the system examines the original software to create a parity testing checklist detailing required behaviors, inputs, outputs, and verification methods, which must be approved by a human operator. The system adheres to strict clean-room development rules by preventing the coding agent from accessing decompiled text from the original software.

During each review cycle, identical inputs are tested on both the original and new builds to verify matching results. A project is deemed complete only when every required feature passes two consecutive review cycles. If a build halts for two cycles or requires protected vendor system access, the agent stops and notifies the human operator. Additionally, the self-learning loop updates the core tool with new test patterns and code examples after each cycle without storing sensitive data or proprietary information.

Founder Adnan Tanveer noted the tool is intended for engineering teams permitted to recreate existing software, and warned users against copying third-party products, bypassing security, or stealing assets. The release integrates two prior agent tools and is compatible with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Speedrun AI Labs primarily develops specialized commercial agents, including a cybersecurity agent named Anton and a financial compliance agent named Joseph.

stories.title: لاہور سیشن کورٹ نے دو غیر ملکی خواتین سے زیادتی کے کیس میں ملزم کی ضمانت منظور کرلی
stories.summary:
لاہور کی سیشن کورٹ نے دو غیر ملکی خواتین سے مبینہ زیادتی اور اغواء کے ایک مقدمے میں گرفتار ملزم کی بعد از گرفتاری ضمانت منظور کر لی ہے۔ ایڈیشنل سیشن جج رفاقت علی گوندل نے اس حوالے سے درخواستِ ضمانت پر اپنا حکم نامہ جاری کیا۔

عدالت کی جانب سے جاری کردہ حکم نامے میں ملزم کو ایک لاکھ روپے کے مچلکوں کے عوض رہا کرنے کا حکم دیا گیا ہے۔ ایف آئی آر کے متن کے مطابق دونوں متاثرہ خواتین انتیس جون کو لاہور پہنچی تھیں، اور ملزم انہیں ڈیفنس میں واقع ایک گھر میں لے کر گیا تھا۔

عدالت نے اپنے فیصلے میں واضح کیا کہ نامزد ملزم پہلے ہی جیل میں قید ہے اور پولیس کو اس معاملے میں مزید تفتیش کے لیے مزید جسمانی حراست کی کوئی ضرورت درکار نہیں۔ بنیادی الزام جائے وقوعہ سے شواہد غائب کرنے سے متعلق ہے جبکہ ملزم ایف آئی آر میں نامزد نہیں تھا۔

عدالت نے تمام قانونی پہلوؤں کا جائزہ لینے کے بعد ملزم ساجد علی کی ضمانت کی درخواست منظور کرنے کا باضابطہ حکم جاری کیا۔ اس کیس کی تفتیش اور عدالت کی کارروائی کے دوران دیگر انتظامی امور بھی ساتھ ساتھ زیر بحث رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: مدھیہ پردیش میں رس گلے کی شکل میں دھماکا، ایک شخص ہلاک
stories.summary:
بھارتی ریاست مدھیہ پردیش کے ضلع ڈنڈوری میں ایک دلخراش واقعے کے دوران رس گلے کے اندر چھپایا گیا دیسی ساختہ بم پھٹنے سے 35 سالہ راجیندر بروتیا ہلاک ہو گئے۔ یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب راجیندر اپنے گھر کے صحن میں اہل خانہ کے ساتھ آگ تاپ رہے تھے اور ان کا پڑوسی رام بھگت سنگھ وہاں آیا۔

رام بھگت نے ہنسی مذاق کے دوران راجیندر کو ایک چھوٹی گیند نما چیز دی اور اسے دیوالی کے تہوار کے حوالے سے رس گلہ بتا کر کھانے کو کہا۔ راجیندر نے جیسے ہی اسے منہ میں رکھ کر چبایا، ایک زوردار دھماکا ہوا جس سے ان کا جبڑا پھٹ گیا اور چہرہ ناقابلِ شناخت ہو گیا۔ اہل خانہ انھیں فوری طور پر آٹو رکشے میں ڈنڈوری ضلع ہسپتال لے گئے جہاں وہ دورانِ علاج دم توڑ گئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق اس قسم کے بم کو 'سور مار بم' یا 'پگ بم' کہا جاتا ہے جو وسطی انڈیا کے دیہی علاقوں میں جنگلی سوروں کو مارنے کے لیے استعمال کیے جاتے ہیں۔ یہ دھماکا خیز مواد عموماً کھانے کی چیزوں میں چھپا کر جنگل میں رکھ دیا جاتا ہے تاکہ جانور کے چبانے پر پھٹ جائے۔

اس معاملے میں پولیس نے رام بھگت سنگھ سمیت دو افراد کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ دوسرا ملزم وہ شخص ہے جسے یہ بم جنگل سے ملا تھا اور اس نے رام بھگت کو دیا تھا۔ پولیس نے بھارتیہ نیائے سنہتا کی دفعہ 105 اور ایکسپلوسِوز ایکٹ کی دفعات 3 اور 4 کے تحت مقدمہ درج کر کے تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے اور جائے وقوعہ سے ملنے والے نمونے فرانزک لیبارٹری بھجوائے جا رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: US Airspace Reopens After Major Technology Outage Causes National Groundstop
stories.summary:
The United States grounded all domestic flights for roughly four hours on Saturday following a major communications outage caused by outdated technology, creating widespread travel disruptions across the country. The nationwide groundstop stranded hundreds of thousands of passengers and marked only the second time such an alert has been issued in US airspace since the September 11 attacks, aside from a minor pilot notification system failure in January 2023.

Federal Aviation Authority officials lifted the groundstop after four hours. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that the incident stemmed from a legacy system problem involving old switches, routers, and 1980s copper lines that became overloaded. Duffy had previously asked Congress on Thursday for $30.1 billion to modernize the US Air Traffic Control System and reiterated the urgent need for these resources following the stoppage.

FlightAware data indicated that nearly 6,000 flights were canceled, including international routes, causing long lines and chaotic scenes at airports nationwide as travelers struggled to find alternative transportation or information. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin stated there was no evidence of foul play, a cyberattack, artificial intelligence involvement, or any connection to a separate Microsoft outage that affected email systems globally.

The unexpected halt left passengers facing prolonged delays and uncertainty during the busy travel period preceding the Thanksgiving holiday. While some travelers faced missed connections and altered plans, others sought out alternative routes, car rentals, or made arrangements to extend their stays with friends.

stories.title: Tesla Slips Out of Top 10 EV Brands in China
stories.summary:
Tesla has dropped out of China's top 10 New Energy Vehicle brands, according to October 2026 retail data from the CPCA passenger car association. During that month, Tesla sold 8,817 NEVs, which encompass both battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids. This performance follows a fourth-place ranking in September and reflects a broader downward trend in the country's market.

Market leader BYD dominated sales with 250,301 NEVs, capturing a 22.4% market share, followed by Geely with 131,708 sales and Leapmotor with 83,573. Meanwhile, Xiaomi Auto climbed to sixth place with 50,123 sales, marking the highest monthly growth among the top ten brands at 25.3% over September figures. For the first ten months of the year, Tesla’s regional sales fell 15.0% to 389,905 units, dropping the company from fifth to seventh place in year-to-date standings.

The decline coincides with a broader contraction in China's automotive sector. Total passenger car sales fell 27.1% year-on-year in October to 1,643,000 units, while NEV sales decreased by 13.7% to 1,109,000. Despite lower overall volume compared to the previous year, NEVs achieved a record 67.5% share of total passenger car retail sales in the world's largest car market.

stories.title: US Lifts Airport Ground Stop, Blames Old Equipment
stories.summary:
United States authorities lifted an hours-long nationwide ground stop at airports on Friday, attributing the severe travel disruption to outdated hardware rather than any cyberattack or Microsoft-related outage. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the reopening of airspace during a late-night White House briefing, noting that traffic flow would recover gradually.

The technical failure occurred when data overloads overwhelmed legacy switches and routers built with 1980s copper lines. The incident arrived just a day after the administration formally asked Congress for $30 billion to modernize the national air traffic control system. Despite the disruption, Duffy maintained that flying remained safe for the public.

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin firmly rejected speculation regarding a coordinated cyber assault or any connection to worldwide issues affecting Microsoft. Mullin stated that security agencies found no digital footprints or threat actor claims, though investigations remained ongoing. Both officials defended President Donald Trump, confirming he stayed in continuous communication with staff throughout the crisis.

stories.title: Massive US Flight Grounding Sparks Nationwide Travel Chaos
stories.summary:
A major communications outage caused by aging technology forced the Federal Aviation Administration to ground all US flights for approximately four hours on Saturday, creating widespread travel chaos. The rare nationwide stoppage left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded at airports and marked only the second time such an emergency measure was implemented since the September 11 attacks, following a previous failure in January 2023.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the nationwide failure on overloaded legacy infrastructure, specifically 1980s copper lines, switches, and routers. Duffy reiterated his urgent request for Congress to approve $30.1 billion in funding to modernize the air traffic control system. FlightAware reported nearly 6,000 canceled flights, forcing frustrated travelers to seek alternative arrangements as airports faced severe congestion ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.

Cabinet officials, including Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, confirmed there was zero evidence pointing to foul play, artificial intelligence threats, or cyberattacks. Mullin also dismissed any link to a separate technical outage that impacted Microsoft services globally earlier in the week. Stranded passengers across various airports expressed frustration over delayed updates and suddenly altered travel plans.

stories.title: Bus Conductor Sacked in Lahore After Pushing Woman
stories.summary:
A private transport company in Lahore terminated a bus conductor's employment on Friday after a video surfaced showing him pushing a woman off a vehicle. The incident, which occurred at a local terminal, quickly spread across social media and provoked widespread public outrage and swift government intervention.

Footage captured the conductor physically pushing the female commuter as she attempted to board, causing her to fall onto a parked motorcycle. In response to the backlash, Punjab Minister for Transport and Mass Transit Bilal Akbar Khan announced that Faisal Movers Group had fired the employee, identified in a disciplinary termination letter as Ali Rizwan of the BRT Lahore service. The minister condemned the behavior and apologized on behalf of the transport department.

Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz deemed simple dismissal insufficient and directed police to pursue further legal measures against the conductor. She instructed DIG Faisal Kamran to apprehend the individual and have him taken directly to the victim's residence to offer a public apology, emphasizing that transport staff are not permitted to mistreat the public.

stories.title: کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں رینجرز کی کارروائی، سات ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
ترجمان رینجرز کے مطابق کراچی کے علاقوں سرجانی ٹاؤن اور نیو کراچی میں سیکیورٹی فورسز نے کامیاب کارروائیاں کرتے ہوئے سات ملزمان کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔ گرفتار ہونے والے افراد ڈکیتی اور اسٹریٹ کرائم کی متعدد وارداتوں میں ملوث بتائے گئے ہیں۔

ترجمان نے مزید بتایا کہ کارروائی کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے تین غیر قانونی پستول، گولیاں، دو موٹر سائیکلیں، چودہ موبائل فونز اور نقدی برآمد کی گئی ہے۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کی جانب سے اسٹریٹ کرائمز کے خلاف شہر بھر میں گشت اور کارروائیوں کا سلسلہ جاری رکھا گیا ہے۔

دوسری جانب ملک بھر کے دیگر اہم قومی امور اور خبریں بھی زیر بحث رہیں۔ پاکستان ریلوے نے اے سی خراب ہونے یا پاور پلانٹ فیل ہونے پر مسافروں کو اضافی کرایہ واپس کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ کراچی یونیورسٹی روڈ حسن اسکوائر سے نیپا تک ترقیاتی کاموں کے باعث بند کر دی گئی ہے۔

حکام کے مطابق قانون نافذ کرنے والے ادارے شہر میں امن و امان کی بحالی اور جرائم پیشہ عناصر کی سرکوبی کے لیے اپنی کارروائیاں جاری رکھے ہوئے ہیں تاکہ شہریوں کے جان و مال کا تحفظ یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: مریم نواز اور وفاقی وزیر کے درمیان تنازع اور سیاسی ہلچل
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے صوبے پنجاب کے سیاسی منظرنامے پر اس وقت ہلچل دیکھی جا رہی ہے جب وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک کے ایک بیان کے بعد حکومتی صفوں میں اختلافات سامنے آئے۔ چوہدری سالک نے ایک نجی چینل کے انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا تھا کہ پنجاب میں کرپشن سے الماریاں بھری ہوئی ہیں، جس کے بعد وزیر اعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے ان کے اس بیان کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے انھیں ہرجانے کا نوٹس جاری کیا۔

وزیر اعلیٰ مریم نواز نے پنڈدادخان اور اٹک میں تقاریر کے دوران اس معاملے پر سخت ردِعمل ظاہر کیا۔ انھوں نے چوہدری سالک کا نام لیے بغیر تنقید کی کہ اگر حکومت اتنی ہی کرپٹ ہے اور اعتراض ہے تو وزراء استعفیٰ دے کر گھر کیوں نہیں چلے جاتے۔ مریم نواز کا کہنا تھا کہ الیکشن قریب آ رہا ہے اور کچھ لوگ اپنی اگلی ارینجمنٹس اور متبادل نظام کے تحت بیانیہ بنا رہے ہیں۔

اس معاملے پر وفاقی وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف اور سابق نگران وزیر اعلیٰ محسن نقوی نے بھی بیانات دیے ہیں۔ خواجہ آصف نے کہا کہ ان کی سیاسی سمجھ کے مطابق ایک متبادل نظام بنانے کی تیاری کی جا رہی ہے تاکہ موجودہ حکومت کو بدنام کیا جا سکے، جس میں کچھ سرمایہ دار بھی شامل ہیں۔ محسن نقوی نے لاہور میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ کرپشن پورے پاکستان میں موجود ہے جسے ختم کرنا حکومت کی ذمہ داری ہے۔

مسلم لیگ ن کے رہنما رانا ثنا اللہ نے اس حوالے سے یاد دلایا کہ 2018 کے الیکشن سے پہلے بھی کرپشن کا شور مچایا گیا تھا لیکن کسی الزام کا ثبوت نہیں دیا گیا تھا۔ نوٹس ملنے کے باوجود چوہدری سالک اپنے بیان پر قائم ہیں اور ان کا کہنا ہے کہ پنجاب حکومت نے ان کی سکیورٹی بھی واپس لے لی ہے۔

سینیئر صحافیوں سہیل وڑائچ اور سلمان غنی کے مطابق یہ تنازع دونوں فریقین کے مفاد میں نہیں ہے اور مارچ تک اس سیٹ اپ میں کوئی تبدیلی نہیں آئے گی۔ تجزیہ کاروں کا کہنا ہے کہ اس کشمکش کے باوجود بالاآخر معاملات طے پا جائیں گے کیونکہ یہ نظام کے مفاد میں بہتر ہے۔

stories.title: امریکہ میں فضائی نظام کی خرابی کے بعد پروازیں چار گھنٹے معطل رہنے کے بعد بحাল
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں فضائی نظام میں اچانک شدید تعطل کے بعد پروازوں کی بحالی کا عمل شروع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ نائن الیون کے بعد پہلی بار ملک بھر میں تمام پروازیں روکنے کا حکم دیا گیا تھا جس کے باعث فضائی آپریشن تقریبا چار گھنٹے تک مکمل معطل رہا۔ وائٹ ہاؤس میں منعقدہ ایک نیوز بریفنگ کے دوران امریکی حکام نے تصدیق کی کہ اس نظامی تعطل کا تعلق کسی بھی قسم کے سائبر حملے یا مائیکروسافٹ کی خرابی سے نہیں تھا۔

امریکی وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ شان ڈفی اور ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کے سیکریٹری مارک وین مولن نے مشترکہ پریس کانفرنس میں بتایا کہ یہ خرابی فرسودہ اور پرانے آلات پر اضافی دباؤ کی وجہ سے پیدا ہوئی۔ وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ نے تسلیم کیا کہ نقل و حمل کا موجودہ نظام پرانا ہو چکا ہے اور اسے جدید بنانے کے لیے فوری طور پر کانگریس کی حمایت درکار ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ مواصلاتی رابطہ وقفے وقفے سے منقطع ہونے کی وجہ سے حکام کو مجبورا فضائی حدود بند کرنے کا انتہائی قدم اٹھانا پڑا۔

حکام نے واضح کیا کہ فضائی ٹریفک کنٹرول کے مراکز اور ٹریکونز اب دوبارہ فعال ہو چکے ہیں، لیکن اس تعطل کے اثرات سے نمٹنے میں مزید چند دن لگ سکتے ہیں۔ آسٹریلیا کے سڈنی ایئرپورٹ سمیت مختلف مقامات پر امریکہ جانے والی پروازیں روکی گئیں یا تاخیر کا شکار ہوئیں۔ دریں اثنا، یونائیٹڈ ایئرلائنز اور امریکن ایئرلائنز سمیت دیگر فضائی کمپنیوں نے مسافروں کو اپنی پروازوں کی تازہ ترین معلومات کے لیے ویب سائٹ چیک کرنے اور متعلقہ اداروں سے رابطے میں رہنے کی ہدایت جاری کی ہے۔

stories.title: Sindh Government Announces One-Window Facility for Builders at ABAD House
stories.summary:
Sindh Minister for Local Government Syed Nasir Hussain Shah announced that a dedicated one-window operation office will be established at ABAD House in Karachi. Inaugurating the three-day ABAD In-House Exhibition on Friday, Mr Shah emphasized the provincial administration's dedication to fostering a favorable business climate and driving investment within the construction sector.

The newly planned facility aims to resolve industry hurdles swiftly by streamlining approval procedures and aiding builders and developers. To achieve this, the Sindh Building Control Authority director general and government officials are collaborating closely alongside ongoing digitalization efforts. Mr Shah noted that more than 150 road infrastructure projects are currently underway throughout Sindh to boost regional development.

Highlighting international recognition, the minister urged stakeholders to concentrate on economic growth and keeping capital within the country rather than transferring funds abroad. He added that the administration is working to enhance governance and refine the Provincial Finance Commission and National Finance Commission frameworks to better support economic initiatives.

Speaking as the guest of honour, Sindh Governor Nihal Hashmi encouraged participating companies to target global markets to strengthen Pakistan's economy through higher exports. He also highlighted that the federal administration, led by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, remains actively engaged in allocating financial resources for ongoing infrastructure development across Karachi.

stories.title: لاہور میں خواجہ سراؤں کی ٹرین ڈرائیور کیبن میں سفر پر مقدمہ
stories.summary:
لاہور میں دو خواجہ سراؤں کے ٹرین کے ڈرائیور کیبن میں سفر کرنے کی ایک ویڈیو منظرِ عام پر آئی ہے۔ اس ویڈیو کے سامنے آنے کے بعد ریلوے حکام کی جانب سے فوری کارروائی عمل میں لائی گئی ہے۔

واقعے کا نوٹس لیتے ہوئے متعلقہ ٹرین کے ڈرائیور اور اسسٹنٹ ٹرین ڈرائیور کے خلاف باضابطہ طور پر مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کی جانب سے اس پورے واقعے کی مزید تحقیقات کا آغاز بھی کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ تمام حقائق کا تعین کیا جا سکے۔

اس کے علاوہ ملک بھر میں دیگر انتظامی اور حکومتی امور بھی زیرِ بحث رہے ہیں۔ پاکستان ریلوے نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ اے سی خراب ہونے یا پاور پلانٹ فیل ہونے کی صورت میں مسافروں کو اضافی کرایہ واپس کیا جائے گا۔

کراچی میں ترقیاتی کاموں کے باعث یونیورسٹی روڈ حسن اسکوائر سے نیپا تک بند کر دی گئی ہے جبکہ پشاور پولیس نے نجی جرگوں پر پابندی عائد کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ مزید برآں، سرکاری افسران کے اثاثوں کے ڈیجیٹل گوشوارے جمع کرانے کی آخری تاریخ میں بھی توسیع کر دی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Heavy Snowfall Strands Passengers and Transport at Khunjerab Pass
stories.summary:
Severe winter weather conditions continued to disrupt Gilgit-Baltistan on Friday, leaving a significant number of travellers, tourists, and commercial vehicles trapped at the Khunjerab Pass along the Pakistan-China border. Continuous heavy snowfall and rain created hazardous conditions, rendering the Karakoram Highway extremely slippery and prompting safety warnings from local law enforcement.

The hazardous road surface caused three shipping containers to skid off the highway, while a Chinese cargo vehicle overturned near Khunjerab Top. Local residents and Khunjerab Security Police personnel swiftly rescued the unhurt driver. Gilgit-Baltistan Minister for Tourism Naiknaam Karim, who was among those stranded, criticized the lack of proactive snow-clearing operations on the Pakistani section of the route, noting that the Chinese side of the pass had already been cleared.

Authorities from the Gilgit-Baltistan police urged the public to avoid unnecessary travel and recommended calling helpline 15 for updates before attempting journeys. Stranded travellers at the high-altitude pass, situated above 15,000 feet, voiced concerns over severe cold and potential oxygen scarcity. Meanwhile, separate rainfall triggered a landslide at Hopper Pari, completely cutting off traffic along the Ghizer-Shandur Road.
