The disruption highlights ongoing infrastructure vulnerabilities during extreme weather events in northern Pakistan, severely impacting cross-border trade and regional mobility. Travelers and transport operators continue to face delays as authorities coordinate emergency responses to clear blocked mountain passes and highways.

stories.title: Asad Mehmood Fails to Appear Before NAB for Second Time
stories.summary:
Asad Mehmood, son of JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, ignored a second summons issued by the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) on Friday. The former federal minister failed to present himself before the bureau's investigation team regarding an ongoing inquiry into alleged recruitment irregularities during his tenure as communications minister in 2022-23.

According to bureau insiders, the NAB Rawalpindi and Islamabad Regional Office had previously issued an initial notice on November 10, which Mr Mehmood also bypassed. Following his non-compliance with the second directive, anti-corruption officials indicated that a third notice would soon be dispatched. Continued failure to respond could result in punitive measures, including potential arrest by the watchdog.

The investigation centers on allegations of procedural violations involving 4,252 appointments made at Pakistan Post while the former minister held office under the Pakistan Democratic Movement coalition government. NAB procedures typically involve issuing up to three sequential notices before taking enforcement action against non-compliant respondents.

The ongoing case forms part of a broader string of anti-corruption inquiries directed at political figures and their associates. The escalation of notices underscores the accountability body's intent to compel cooperation regarding public sector appointments made during the previous administration.

stories.title: Balochistan Assembly Resolves to Make Basic Arabic Compulsory in Schools
stories.summary:
The Balochistan Assembly unanimously passed a resolution on Friday recommending the inclusion of basic Arabic as a mandatory subject in all government-run primary schools across the province. JUI-F Member of Provincial Assembly Shahida Rauf introduced the motion, emphasizing that early instruction in the language would help students comprehend commonly used Quranic terminology and expressions.

The approved resolution outlines a structured framework, advocating for a simplified, grade-wise curriculum focusing on fundamental vocabulary and basic grammar. It also underscores the necessity of deploying qualified educators, supplying adequate textbooks, and establishing robust monitoring mechanisms. Implementation is proposed through a phased rollout tailored to the developmental capacities and educational needs of young learners.

During the assembly session, MPA Dr Abdul Malik Baloch drew attention to previous legislative efforts enacted in 2013 to advance education in regional mother languages. He urged the provincial government to ensure that earlier educational mandates are enforced alongside the newly recommended Arabic instruction initiative.

The unanimous adoption reflects broad legislative support for integrating religious and linguistic studies into foundational schooling throughout the province. Officials hope the structured phased program will improve students' comprehension skills from an early age under careful institutional oversight.

stories.title: US Federal Aviation Administration Lifts Nationwide Flight Ground Stop
stories.summary:
The US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday after a communications failure at air traffic control centers caused severe airport chaos. This incident triggered the longest nationwide flight shutdown since the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks, highlighting deep strain on the American air traffic system.

According to FlightRadar24, the disruption resulted in more than 4,700 canceled flights and 10,000 delays on Friday, with another 700 cancellations already logged for Saturday. Aviation analysts indicated that airlines would likely need several days to fully restore their operational schedules following the grounding, which lasted over four hours.

The Department of Homeland Security stated that there was no indication of a cyberattack causing the outage. The event represents the latest and most dramatic breakdown for a US air traffic control network that has struggled with equipment failures, communications issues, controller shortages, and aging infrastructure.

Prior to this event, the only other nationwide ground stop since the September 11 attacks occurred in January 2023, when domestic departures were halted for approximately 90 minutes. The situation underscores ongoing vulnerabilities within the nation's critical aviation infrastructure.

stories.title: UNDP Chief Warns of Doubled Costs Without Immediate El Nino Action
stories.summary:
United Nations Development Programme chief Alexander De Croo warned delegates on Friday at the COP31 talks in Turkey that failing to act immediately against the impacts of El Nino will double future financial costs. Speaking in the resort city of Antalya, De Croo stated that hedging against El Nino requires $36 billion currently, whereas inaction will drive expenses up to $73 billion.

El Nino warms Pacific Ocean waters every two to seven years, altering global wind patterns and rainfall, and this exceptionally strong cycle has already damaged economies worldwide. De Croo urged institutions like the International Monetary Fund and wealthy nations to support vulnerable developing countries, noting that vulnerable regions have endured compounding crises including the Covid-19 pandemic, the war in Ukraine, the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, and high financing costs.

A UN report highlighted estimates from the African Development Bank of $10 billion to $20 billion in regional damage, while the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean projected cumulative GDP losses of at least two percent over three years, pushing 4.8 million people into poverty. De Croo pressed for immediate adaptation investments across 47 partner nations.

Meanwhile, on the sidelines of the Antalya summit, sources revealed that China has decided against hosting the 2028 COP33 climate talks. Beijing's withdrawal leaves the opportunity open for another Asia-Pacific nation to organize the event, following India's withdrawal of its offer in April and previous expressions of interest by South Korea.

stories.title: Senator Sherry Rehman Urges Credible Financing Framework at COP31 Talks
stories.summary:
Senator Sherry Rehman called for the COP31 conference in Antalya to move past mere declarations and establish a credible, accessible, and equitable climate financing framework. In a statement issued on Friday, she warned that climate-vulnerable nations like Pakistan are trapped in a dangerous cycle of disasters, debt, and declining development opportunities.

Rehman expressed appreciation for Turkiye's leadership in hosting COP31 amidst geopolitical divisions and climate emergencies, hoping the event translates climate solidarity into concrete financial outcomes. She criticized the contradiction between climate goals and continued fossil fuel support, pointing out that global fossil fuel subsidies reach approximately $7 trillion while vulnerable nations struggle to fund basic adaptation and recovery.

Highlighting alarming global temperature trajectories, Rehman noted that current policies point toward roughly 2.7 degrees centigrade of warming by the end of the century, pushing the 1.5 degrees centigrade threshold out of reach. She warned that such warming would have devastating consequences for countries like Pakistan, undermining food security, water availability, and economic stability.

Recalling national impacts, Rehman noted that the 2022 floods affected 33 million people and caused about $30 billion in damages and losses, while agricultural losses from 2025 floods reached $1 billion. She emphasized that Pakistan is demanding climate justice and financial accountability rather than charity.

stories.title: Yemeni Government Forces Fortify Defenses Around Aden Amid Advance
stories.summary:
Yemeni military officials reported that the internationally recognised government is fortifying positions on the outskirts of Aden province, which hosts their de facto capital. The defensive measures come as Houthi forces capture strategic hilltops and advance eastward following the collapse of a 2022 truce.

Violence has escalated significantly since the Saudi-backed government lost control of the Red Sea coastline along the Bab al-Mandab strait in September. The Houthis have consolidated gains near the Red Sea and moved closer to the Gulf of Aden, seizing strategic hilltops in the Al-Madaribah wal Ara district overlooking Aden province.

A military official confirmed receiving high-level directives to establish military fortifications, including stacking sandbags and digging tunnels, west and north of Aden Governorate as threats draw nearer. Government forces have repeatedly attempted to retake the Red Sea coast without success, resulting in dozens of casualties on both sides over recent days.

Additionally, a field officer stated that the Houthis captured the Al-Maqatirah region, home to the main gateway road to Taiz, which has been under Houthi siege for weeks. This capture complicates government efforts to retake Taiz and facilitates further Houthi advances toward the Gulf of Aden coast.

stories.title: WASA Lahore Launches Advanced Smart Water Metering System in Johar Town
stories.summary:
The Water and Sanitation Agency (WASA) Lahore has formally launched a smart water metering system in Johar Town as part of an urban resource management and digital transformation initiative. During the initial phase, 1,000 advanced ultrasonic smart water meters were successfully installed and made operational, moving the utility away from traditional flat-rate billing toward consumption-based management.

Following the Johar Town pilot project, WASA Lahore plans to deploy an additional 10,000 smart meters over the next three months to promote responsible and sustainable water use across the city. WASA Lahore Managing Director Ghufran Ahmed visited Johar Town to inspect the new infrastructure and centralized device management dashboard, where Director Planning and Evaluation Mudassar Javed briefed him on telemetry networks, real-time data streaming, and system performance parameters.

The new infrastructure bills consumers strictly based on actual water usage to foster conservation and accountability. WASA has integrated the system with the Punjab WASA mobile app, allowing residents to monitor daily consumption trends, review meter reading histories, and download water bills directly from their mobile devices.

WASA leadership highlighted that the ultrasonic meters are effective in preventing resource loss, stopping water wastage, deterring unauthorized water theft, and eliminating illegal connections. Furthermore, real-time data feeds allow for more accurate assessments of fluctuating urban water demand and supply patterns.

stories.title: UHS Launches Province-Wide Digital Platform to Monitor Medical Education
stories.summary:
The University of Health Sciences has introduced a province-wide digital system named PRIME to integrate medical and health professions education, clinical training, and competency assessments. Provincial Minister for Specialized Healthcare and Medical Education Khawaja Salman Rafique inaugurated the platform at a ceremony in Lahore. The initiative aims to enhance transparency, accountability, and quality assurance through digital oversight.

The initial phase of the portal will cover approximately 3,300 postgraduate medical and dental trainees in MS, MD, and MDS programs across 33 training institutions in Punjab, alongside around 1,100 registered supervisors. The system replaces traditional paper logbooks with electronic records detailing clinical cases, attendance, rotations, research, and workplace assessments. Institutional dashboards will allow the university to monitor training standards and address shortcomings.

Minister Khawaja Salman Rafique noted that improving healthcare is a primary objective of Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif's administration. He emphasized that modern medical facilities require a well-trained workforce capable of making sound clinical decisions rather than merely increasing the number of medical degrees. UHS Vice Chancellor Maj Gen Prof. Sohail Sabir stated that future phases will expand the platform to undergraduate MBBS and BDS programs, house-job training, and eventually nursing, pharmacy, and allied health sciences.

Director of Postgraduate Studies Prof. Muhammad Asif Naveed explained that the portal features continuous internal evaluations, workplace assessments such as Mini-CEX and DOPS, and a learning management system. The platform matters because it enables administrators to track progress and implement corrective measures during training rather than depending entirely on final examinations, ensuring a more competent healthcare workforce across roughly 230 supervised institutions in Punjab.

stories.title: Goalkeeper Jesus Owono Suspended for 12 Matches After Fatal Collision
stories.summary:
Spanish football authorities have handed FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono a 12-match suspension. The disciplinary committee of the Spanish football federation imposed the ban following a fatal on-field collision involving the Equatorial Guinea international and Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

The tragic incident occurred on November 2 during a second-division match when Owono rushed into midfield to clear an aerial ball and collided heavily with De Miguel. The Tenerife player received initial medical treatment on the pitch before being transported to a hospital and placed in the intensive care unit.

Although De Miguel's condition was initially reported as stable, it rapidly deteriorated, and he passed away on November 3. The tragedy has triggered routine legal procedures under Spanish law, which mandates a judicial inquiry and a police investigation into all non-natural deaths to examine potential involuntary manslaughter.

Despite the ongoing police scrutiny, prosecutors have indicated that formal criminal proceedings against the goalkeeper are unlikely. The suspension serves as the immediate sporting penalty enforced by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee following the second-tier match.

stories.title: PIDE Roundtable Urges Export-Oriented Approach to Regional Trade Agreements
stories.summary:
Speakers at a roundtable conference in Islamabad organized by the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics called for a strategic shift toward an export-oriented approach in the country's trade agreements. Titled "From Signing to Exporting: Exploring the Export-Promoting Role of Trade Agreements," the event featured experts from organizations such as the WTO, Economic Advisory Group, Pakistan Business Council, and APTMA. The discussion focused on how imports from regional trade agreement partners have outpaced exports since 2000.

Dr. Amjad Masood, Chief of Research and Director at CTLI, presented report findings indicating that each dollar of imports from RTA partners is currently matched by only about 20 cents of exports. The presented report advocates for a framework focused on export-driven negotiations, industrial policy alignment, demand-based partner selection, sanitary and phytosanitary access alongside tariff reductions, and key performance indicator reviews at the Ministry of Commerce. Former WTO ambassador Dr. Ahmad noted that Pakistan's agreements have largely underperformed, with the Turkiye pact covering only two percent of trade.

Participants discussed various systemic hurdles contributing to the trade lag. Dr. Vaqar Ahmed suggested treating free trade agreement offers as steps toward unilateral liberalization, while Sarrah Javad of APTMA pointed out that secured market access frequently excludes tariff lines relevant to actual exporters. Javed Kureishi of the Pakistan Business Council emphasized the need for designated leads and follow-up protocols for reviews. Other speakers, including Dr. Zafar Mahmood and Dr. Adil Nakhoda, stressed that Pakistan must translate preferential access into global competitiveness by improving economic diplomacy and integrating into global value chains.

The conference highlights a critical need for simpler customs procedures, paperless processes, and inclusive reforms to overcome trade facilitation delays. Reforming these trade agreements matters because it could unlock significant export potential, improve business competitiveness globally, and address the widening trade imbalances stemming from regional pacts established over the past two decades.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Sharif Praises Overseas Pakistanis for Strengthening UK Relations
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif commended the role of overseas Pakistanis in enhancing bilateral relations between Pakistan and the United Kingdom during a ceremony at the British High Commission in Islamabad. Celebrating the 77th birthday of Britain's King Charles III, Sharif noted that nearly two million British citizens of Pakistani origin serve as an essential bridge and make valuable contributions across various sectors in the UK. He also lauded King Charles III for a public service career that inspires millions across the Commonwealth.

During the event, Sharif expressed gratitude to the British government and British High Commissioner Jane Marriott for their condolences regarding recent terrorist attacks in Islamabad and other regions of Pakistan. Reaffirming national resolve, he stated that Pakistan remains determined to eliminate terrorism with the backing of its armed forces and people. He recalled past interactions with the British monarch and expressed appreciation for High Commissioner Marriott's efforts in facilitating the resumption of Pakistan International Airlines flights to Manchester, while extending an invitation to King Charles III and Queen Camilla to visit Pakistan.

British High Commissioner Jane Marriott reciprocated condolences and reaffirmed the UK's support for Pakistan, highlighting the strong bilateral relationship. She noted that bilateral trade has reached £5.5 billion annually and pointed out that 15 British Members of Parliament of Pakistani origin currently serve in the UK Parliament, including Shabana Mahmood, the first Muslim woman appointed as the United Kingdom's Home Secretary.

The event underscores the multifaceted partnership between the two nations, driven by diaspora engagement, growing economic ties, and diplomatic cooperation. Recognizing these contributions matters for maintaining robust diplomatic channels, fostering economic collaboration, and addressing shared global security and counter-terrorism objectives.

stories.title: PHMA Praises Rs300 Billion SME Export Finance Reserve for FY2026-27
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Hosiery Manufacturers & Exporters Association (PHMA) has officially welcomed the government's decision to allocate Rs300 billion exclusively for small and medium enterprises (SMEs). This dedicated funding falls under the Pak EXIM-administered Export Finance Scheme (E-EFS) for the fiscal year 2026-27. PHMA Chairman Syed Zia Alamdar Hussain stated that this move highlights the administration's strong dedication to bolstering the SME sector, enhancing access to budget-friendly financing, and driving export-led economic expansion.

Highlighting leadership contributions, the chairman expressed gratitude toward Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, the Ministry of Finance, and Pak EXIM Bank for enabling this crucial support for SME exporters. He pointed out that securing affordable working capital has historically been a major obstacle for smaller-scale exporters who strive to scale up their production capacities, fulfill fresh export orders, and maintain competitiveness in global markets.

According to the PHMA chief, dedicating the entire Rs300 billion fund to qualified SMEs will supply targeted financial backing and boost their market competitiveness. He emphasized that SMEs play a vital role in the country's industrial and export landscape by driving employment creation, industrial diversification, entrepreneurship, and sustainable economic progress. Furthermore, the initiative is expected to motivate smaller businesses to venture into export markets, scale their operations, and contribute more effectively to national foreign exchange reserves.

To ensure maximum impact, Hussain urged participating banks to process financial requests transparently, swiftly, and without hassle, allowing funds to reach authentic SME exporters without unwarranted delays. He also called on financial institutions to clearly outline eligibility criteria and assist deserving enterprises in utilizing the scheme. Concluding his remarks, Hussain reaffirmed the PHMA's dedication to collaborating closely with state institutions to promote national textile, hosiery, and knitwear exports while elevating the country's standing globally.

stories.title: Punjab Drafts Food Fortification Bill 2026 to Combat Malnutrition
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has drafted the Punjab Food Fortification Bill 2026, which introduces mandatory fortification for flour, ghee, cooking oil, and salt. The proposed legislation aims to tackle child malnutrition, stunting, and nutritional deficiencies among women across the province. Provincial Minister for Food Safety and Consumer Protection, Salma Butt, announced that the draft was prepared for approval following instructions from Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif.

The minister revealed these details during a meeting she chaired, which included key attendees such as Secretary of Food Safety Dr. Kiran Khurshid, Director General of Food Safety Anwar Jappa, Punjab Food Authority Director General Raja Mansoor, and other senior officials. Butt noted that 27.3 percent of children under five in Punjab currently suffer from stunted growth, reflecting an improvement from 31.5 percent in 2017 following various government interventions. Additionally, alarming levels of iron and zinc deficiencies among women aged 15 to 49 necessitated the introduction of this new regulatory framework.

Under the guidelines of the proposed bill, compliance with fortification requirements for flour, ghee, cooking oil, and salt will be compulsory for producers. Manufacturers who fail to register in accordance with the Food Authority Act will face penalties including up to three months in prison and fines reaching Rs1 million. Furthermore, obstructing food safety officers or failing to adhere to fortification standards can lead to imprisonment of up to six months and fines as high as Rs2 million.

The legislation also requires all manufacturers and importers to conduct daily internal checks, rapid testing, and strict quality assurance protocols. Stringent laboratory testing and production monitoring will be implemented to safeguard the quality of micronutrient premixes utilized in food processing. Butt stressed that fully cooperating with food safety officers and supplying accurate data will remain a legal obligation for all relevant organizations striving to secure a healthier province.

stories.title: FBR Denies Written Tests Amid Training Needs Assessment Controversy
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) is scheduled to hold a training needs assessment in Lahore for Inland Revenue officials in Grade-17 and above. This follows the completion of similar evaluations in Islamabad and Karachi aimed at measuring the sales tax and income tax capabilities of tax officers. A senior FBR official addressed recent misconceptions regarding the capability assessment previously conducted in Karachi.

FBR representatives firmly rejected claims that written exams had taken place during the Karachi evaluation. The official explained that the exercise was merely a routine 'training needs assessment' conducted by the bureau based on identified requirements, stressing that it should not be treated as a formal written test of tax personnel. This clarification follows a viral social media report claiming that out of tested officers, only a small fraction were deemed capable of independently adjudicating tax cases.

Dismissing the circulated figures as inauthentic, the FBR official questioned the validity of the social media report, pointing out the absence of official signatures or stamps and suggesting it could easily be generated via artificial intelligence tools like Claude AI. Nevertheless, the leaked report sparked intense debates regarding the legality, transparency, methodology, and underlying purposes of surprise competency checks administered to FBR officers recruited through competitive examinations.

Critics have raised questions concerning whether such limited assessments can legally justify questioning the competence of career civil servants under existing service rules, or if they are intended to push a narrative of institutional failure that favors external consultants. As calls grow for an independent review of the evaluation framework, transparency regarding AI involvement, and fair appeal mechanisms, affected officers continue to express worries over professional reputational damage and institutional morale.

stories.title: CERP Urges Data-Driven Research to Improve Public and Private Policy
stories.summary:
Data-based research serves as an essential foundation for enhancing the quality of decision-making and policymaking to stimulate growth across both public and private sectors, according to Mehar Tiwana, Director Learning Hub at the Centre for Economic Research in Pakistan (CERP). Speaking to the business community at the Faisalabad Chamber of Commerce and Industry (FCCI), she explained that CERP partners with global experts to conduct strategic research on indigenous issues aimed at improving public policy. She emphasized that unbiased data remains crucial for high-level decision-making and cited Punjab Chief Minister's data-driven policies that improved women's economic participation through enhanced mobility.

Tiwana shared that CERP has investigated urban issues in Karachi and Sialkot while also organizing specialized courses for bureaucrats. Addressing local queries, she suggested conducting a study to evaluate the potential advantages and disadvantages of designating Faisalabad as Pakistan's first 'Textile Circular City', noting its beneficial impacts on the broader economy, environment, and sustainability. She added that CERP could secure initial local funding to pinpoint basic challenges while exploring global funding sources for long-term solutions.

FCCI President Arif Ehsan Malik welcomed the CERP delegation and highlighted the growing role of data-driven methods, artificial intelligence, and modern technology in driving global industrial development. He encouraged Faisalabad industrialists to utilize authentic data for production, pricing, and supply chain strategies to keep their export surpluses globally competitive. Malik proposed establishing a joint industrial database, launching AI pilot projects for select manufacturing units, initiating SME training programs, and creating a permanent platform for research and policy dialogue.

Group leader and former FCCI President Mian Javed Iqbal echoed the need for capacity building across public and private sectors to achieve comprehensive national development. He noted that Faisalabad's numerous small and cottage power loom units struggle to secure funds for immediate challenges, making global funding essential for regional economic uplift. Highlighting that Faisalabad already recycles 60 to 65 percent of the nation's textile waste, Iqbal and Malik advocated for recognizing the city as a pioneer in circular textiles before presenting an honorary FCCI shield to Tiwana and Associate Director Jahanara Amin.

stories.title: سوشل میڈیا پر مشہور ’ڈی ایچ اے والی میڈ‘ مٹھائی کے اشتہار میں جلوہ گر
stories.summary:
سوشل میڈیا پر گھریلو ملازمہ کی روزمرہ زندگی، کام کاج اور خاندانی مصروفیات پر ویڈیوز بنا کر شہرت حاصل کرنے والی پاکستانی ٹک ٹاکر اور یوٹیوبر، جو ’ڈی ایچ اے والی میڈ‘ کے نام سے جانی جاتی ہیں، نے کامیابی کا ایک نیا سنگ میل عبور کر لیا ہے۔ انہیں پہلی مرتبہ ایک معروف مٹھائی کے برانڈ کے اشتہار میں دیکھا گیا ہے۔

اس نئے اشتہار میں ان کے ساتھ دوسری سوشل میڈیا انفلوئنسر امتُل بھی موجود ہیں۔ اشتہار کی جھلکیاں سامنے آنے کے بعد سوشل میڈیا صارفین اور مداحوں کی جانب سے ان کی اس کامیابی پر انتہائی خوشی کا اظہار کیا گیا ہے اور انہیں مستقبل کے لیے مبارکبادیں اور نیک تمناؤں سے نوازا گیا ہے۔

حال ہی میں اس انفلوئنسر نے ’پاکستان انفلوئنسر ایوارڈز‘ میں معروف یوٹیوبر اقرا کنول کو پیچھے چھوڑتے ہوئے ایک اہم اعزاز بھی اپنے نام کیا تھا، جس نے ان کی مقبولیت میں مزید اضافہ کیا۔

ان کی اس نئی کامیابی نے سوشل میڈیا کی دنیا میں ان کے مقام کو مزید مستحکم کر دیا ہے اور مداح ان کی اس پیش رفت کو سراہ رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Federal Board of Revenue Data Reveals Stark Gender Workforce Disparity
stories.summary:
Data concerning actual filled posts within the Federal Board of Revenue shows that women account for only 9.55 percent of the total workforce, while men occupy over 90 percent. Out of 19,549 filled positions across Basic Pay Scales 1 to 22, male employees occupy 16,777 posts compared to just 1,772 filled by women. This significant imbalance is evident across all organizational grades.

In senior positions spanning BPS 17 to 22, women hold 523 of the 3,198 filled roles, representing roughly 16.4 percent. Within these higher grades, representation includes three women out of eight positions at BPS-22, nine out of 50 at BPS-21, 71 out of 306 at BPS-20, 106 out of 464 at BPS-19, 188 out of 794 at BPS-18, and 146 out of 1,576 at BPS-17.

The lower pay scales, BPS 1 to 16, contain the bulk of the organization's staff with 16,351 filled posts. Within this bracket, women occupy 1,249 positions, or approximately 7.6 percent, while men hold 15,102. BPS-16 has the highest absolute number of female employees in the agency with 523 women out of 3,117 filled posts.

Conversely, certain lower pay grades show extremely limited female participation. For example, BPS-5 contains 210 women out of 3,697 filled positions, while BPS-4 has only two female employees out of 593 total workers. Understanding these employment metrics matters as it highlights the demographic breakdown and administrative challenges within the country's primary tax authority.

stories.title: Business Leaders in Lahore Demand Transparent Customs Valuation System
stories.summary:
Business representatives in Lahore have urged authorities to implement a transparent, consistent, and business-friendly customs valuation process grounded in actual transaction data and international market prices. During a consultative session held at the Lahore Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LCCI), stakeholders warned that unrealistic assessments and slow procedures are raising operational expenses and hindering industrial and trade sectors.

The meeting was led by LCCI President Ali Hussam Asghar and featured key figures including Saima Aftab, Director of the Directorate General of Customs Valuation in Lahore, Senior Vice President Sardar Usman Ghani, Vice President Chaudhry Khadim Hussain, and Masood Ahmed Wain, Chairman of the All Pakistan Customs Clearing Agents Association. Asghar stressed that authorities should consult stakeholders prior to making valuation changes and called for faster clearance mechanisms to eliminate damaging delays.

Saima Aftab highlighted the necessity of achieving consensus among commercial importers, local manufacturers, and other sectors to safeguard diverse interests, confirming that the ongoing dialogue will help officials grasp market realities. Meanwhile, Usman Ghani cautioned that inflated valuations lead to higher duties and taxes that damage domestic industries and exports, noting that imports such as industrial components and steel grades require assessment based on technical specifications and actual international rates.

Participants voiced deep frustration over assessments relying on local retail prices and internet listings rather than genuine international trade data. They urged officials to adopt uniform criteria, review prolonged appeal procedures, and stop unnecessary cargo detentions. Furthermore, they requested upgraded customs facilities in Lahore to spare Punjab-based traders the costly and time-consuming journeys to Karachi for import procedures.

stories.title: Lyari Receives First Portable Boxing Ring to Support Women's Boxing
stories.summary:
Young female athletes in Karachi’s Lyari neighborhood have received their first portable boxing ring, marking a significant milestone for grassroots sports in the traditionally boxing-centric community. The new facility was donated by Sehan Vital Fusion to help nurture young talent and expand training opportunities for girls.

The equipment was officially unveiled during a female boxing exhibition held at TMC Bhutto Wala School on Juma Baloch Road in Agra Taj Colony, located next to the Pak Shaheen Boxing Club. The event featured six competitive bouts across weight categories spanning from 26kg to 50kg, drawing substantial interest from local residents, schoolchildren, and boxing fans.

Organizers and coaches emphasized that the donation aims to overcome infrastructural deficits in underserved areas. Dr Naseem Shekhani, president of Sehan Vital Fusion, stated that the initiative ensures children from disadvantaged backgrounds are not hindered by a lack of basic facilities. Younis Qambrani, a former national boxer and head coach at Pak Shaheen, added that the portable ring gives female athletes the right environment to prepare for higher-level competitions.

The exhibition bouts resulted in victories for Hafifa, Nazmeen Sanghar, Hoorian, Eman, Seema, and Manahil, representing various local clubs and institutions. Lyari possesses a deep-rooted heritage in boxing, but aspiring female athletes have historically faced severe resource constraints, making the new ring an important addition to the area's sports culture.

stories.title: Pakistan Single Window and Alibaba.com Launch Digital Trade Confirmation Service
stories.summary:
Pakistan Single Window (PSW) and Alibaba.com have forged an agreement to launch a digital Trade Data Confirmation Service. This initiative merges PSW's digital trade framework with Alibaba.com's international B2B marketplace to bolster trust and support local businesses in expanding their footprint within global e-commerce environments.

The newly introduced service offers an extra layer of verification for Alibaba.com and its worldwide buyers. Authentication occurs through API-based requests and responses, ensuring that the underlying trade data is never transferred or exchanged. By connecting Pakistani enterprises with global buyers, Alibaba.com provides digital tools for discovering new markets, which the confirmation service will further back by independently verifying export declarations.

Syed Aftab Haider, CEO of PSW, noted that the collaboration exemplifies how national digital trade infrastructure can empower innovative services to reinforce supply chain integrity and transparency. He emphasized that API integration creates valuable opportunities for cooperation between government-mandated single window systems and private digital platforms.

Summer Gao, Head of Pakistan Business at Alibaba.com, stated that the partnership will set a fresh benchmark for reliability and transparency in international e-commerce. She expressed confidence that the service will give stronger backing to Pakistani companies as they navigate and scale up within global markets.

stories.title: لکی مروت میں دو سالہ بچے کے قتل میں ملوث دو ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا کے ضلع لکی مروت میں دو ہفتے قبل پیش آنے والے دو سالہ بچے سہیل خان کے قتل کے کیس میں اہم پیشرفت ہوئی ہے جہاں پولیس نے کارروائی کرتے ہوئے دو ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ ڈی پی او سجاد احمد صاحبزادہ کے مطابق اس گھناؤنے جرم میں ملوث گرفتار ملزمان کی شناخت نعیم اللہ اور رمضان کے نام سے ہوئی ہے۔

وانڈہ شہاب خیل میں پیش آنے والا یہ واقعہ پولیس کے لیے ایک ٹیسٹ کیس کی حیثیت رکھتا تھا، جس کی تفتیش ڈی پی او کی نگرانی میں ایک خصوصی انویسٹی گیشن ٹیم کر رہی تھی۔ ایس پی انویسٹی گیشن شیر حسن کے مطابق گرفتار ملزمان نے دورانِ تفتیش بچے کے قتل کا اعتراف کر لیا ہے۔

پولیس نے دونوں ملزمان کو عدالت میں پیش کر کے ان کا تین روزہ جسمانی ریمانڈ حاصل کر لیا ہے۔ حکام کے مطابق اس کیس میں استعمال ہونے والے آلہ قتل کی برآمدگی کے لیے مزید تحقیقات اور کارروائیاں جاری رکھی جا رہی ہیں۔

stories.title: Punjab Minister Announces Launch of Second and Third Phases of Sohna Punjab Programme
stories.summary:
Punjab Local Government Minister Zeeshan Rafique announced that work has officially commenced on the second and third phases of the 'Maryam Nawaz Ka Sohna Punjab' programme, following the successful delivery of its first phase across 51 cities. The update was shared during a Friday meeting reviewing active schemes under the Punjab Development Program (PDP).

Highlighting the vision of Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif, Rafique stressed that city beautification remains a primary objective. He detailed that the local government department is currently constructing 61 kilometres of new drains and renovating 63 kilometres of dilapidated stormwater drains across 51 municipalities. Additionally, plans include building 4,135 kilometres of sewers and 1,245 kilometres of roads.

The programme also encompasses the construction and rehabilitation of 4,146 kilometres of streets alongside various disposal stations, with work on 40 disposal stations already underway in different cities. To combat urban flooding, municipal bodies in the covered cities have received 70 new machines, while the procurement of an additional 217 machines is currently in progress.

The review meeting was attended by several officials, including PDP Project Director Shahid Zaman Lak, Additional Secretary Mehreen Fahim Abbasi, relevant Assistant Project Directors, and Municipal Officers Infrastructure (MOI).

stories.title: پولو ورلڈ کپ کوالیفائرز: پاکستان نے روایتی حریف بھارت کو شکست دیدی
stories.summary:
نائجیریا میں جاری 13ویں پولو ورلڈ کپ زون ای کوالیفائرز کے دوران پاکستان نے اپنے دوسرے میچ میں روایتی حریف بھارت کو شاندار شکست سے دوچار کر دیا۔ اس ٹورنامنٹ میں پاکستان کے علاوہ ایران، بھارت اور میزبان نائیجیریا کی ٹیمیں حصہ لے رہی ہیں۔

قومی ٹیم نے میچ میں بہترین کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے بھارت کو چار کے مقابلے میں سات گول سے ہرا دیا۔ اس سے قبل اپنے پہلے میچ میں بھی پاکستان نے ایران کو چھ کے مقابلے میں دس گول سے شکست دی تھی۔

مسلسل دو شاندار فتوحات حاصل کرنے کے بعد پاکستان کے رواں پولو ورلڈ کپ کے لیے کوالیفائی کرنے کے امکانات انتہائی روشن ہو گئے ہیں۔

قومی پولو ٹیم اپنا آخری اور فیصلہ کن میچ اتوار کے روز میزبان ملک نائیجیریا کے خلاف کھیلے گی۔ اس آخری میچ میں کامیابی کی صورت میں پاکستانی ٹیم براہِ راست یوراگوے میں شیڈولڈ ورلڈ کپ کے لیے رسائی حاصل کر لے گی۔

stories.title: Punjab Revenue Authority Introduces Digital Payment Rewards for Hotel Customers
stories.summary:
The Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA) is preparing to roll out a reward scheme for customers who use digital payment methods at hotels and restaurants. This initiative forms part of a broader strategy to encourage electronic transactions and foster a robust culture of tax compliance across commercial sectors.

The plan was finalized during a digital monitoring and database management meeting headed by PRA Chairman Moazzam Iqbal Sipra, where attendees reviewed priority measures to expand tax compliance and e-payments. Sipra instructed relevant teams to prioritize consumer complaints concerning digital payment platforms and to establish an efficient system for addressing them swiftly.

A PRA spokesperson explained that patrons using QR codes for payments at qualifying establishments will become eligible to win prizes, shifting public habits away from cash dependency. The agency warned that any businesses rejecting QR code payments will face stringent legal consequences under the law.

Officials noted that boosting digital transactions will enhance transparency in business dealings and elevate public trust in the tax framework. Alongside the awareness campaign targeting the restaurant and hotel sector, authorities will implement a monitoring mechanism and utilize the Electronic Invoice Monitoring System (EIMS) to maintain accurate oversight of commercial activity and tax submissions.

stories.title: Trump Administration Seeks $50 Billion for Air Traffic Control After Outage
stories.summary:
The Trump administration increased its funding request for air traffic control to $50 billion late Friday following a communications failure that triggered a nationwide ground stop and halted thousands of flights. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and the White House initially requested $30.1 billion earlier on Friday before boosting the total amount.

The disruption affected the Federal Aviation Administration's en route centers, which manage traffic between airports. Officials described the situation as an emergency, noting that the national airspace relies on decades-old analog infrastructure that struggles with modern demands. The total request encompasses $10.1 billion specifically for modernization, including $7.2 billion for a common automation platform and controller workstations along with $2 billion for cloud computing.

Additionally, the proposal includes $2 billion to replace air traffic control towers and $18 billion for airport-related projects, such as $10.1 billion to modernize aging terminals. Major carriers including American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, and Southwest Airlines have voiced their support for the funding package as Congress navigates the final weeks of the legislative session.

The urgency follows a series of recent disruptions, including a September incident where a circuit failure in Philadelphia and a severed fiber-optic cable in New Jersey caused widespread delays across the Northeast. The FAA currently utilizes decades-old computers and replacement parts sourced from auction websites, though it recently announced plans to replace floppy disks used for critical weather data at over 400 facilities by the end of 2028.

stories.title: لوئر دیر میں تیز رفتار گاڑیوں کی زد میں آنے والی طالبہ معجزانہ طور پر بچ گئی
stories.summary:
لوئر دیر کے علاقے کوٹو بازار میں ایک انتہائی خطرناک سڑک حادثہ پیش آنے سے رہ گیا جہاں ایک طالبہ تیز رفتار گاڑیوں کی زد میں آنے کے باوجود معجزانہ طور پر محفوظ رہی۔ اس پرامید واقعے کی سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج سوشل میڈیا پر تیزی سے وائرل ہو گئی ہے جس نے دیکھنے والوں کو حیران کر دیا ہے۔

وائرل ہونے والی سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج میں واضح طور پر دیکھا جا سکتا ہے کہ مذکورہ طالبہ کوٹو بازار میں سڑک عبور کرنے کی کوشش کر رہی تھی۔ اسی دوران دو تیز رفتار گاڑیاں عین اس جگہ پر پہنچ گئیں اور طالبہ ان دونوں تیز رفتار گاڑیوں کے درمیان آ گئی۔

خوش قسمتی اور اللہ کے کرم سے طالبہ اس خوفناک حادثے کا شکار ہونے سے بال بال بچ گئی۔ اس واقعے کے دوران کسی بھی قسم کا جانی نقصان یا چوٹ کی اطلاع سامنے نہیں آئی اور لڑکی اس حادثے کے بعد محفوظ رہی۔

اس واقعے کی ویڈیو منظر عام پر آنے کے بعد سوشل میڈیا پر موضوعِ بحث بنی ہوئی ہے اور لوگ اس معجزانہ بچت پر حیرت کا اظہار کر رہے ہیں۔ واقعہ اور اس کی فوٹیج نے ٹریفک کے دوران سڑک عبور کرنے میں احتیاط کی اہمیت کو بھی اجاگر کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Islamabad to Host 30th ECO Council of Foreign Ministers Meeting
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that the capital city of Islamabad will host the 30th Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Foreign Ministers on November 15-16. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar is scheduled to preside over the upcoming diplomatic gathering. Attendees will include foreign ministers, delegation heads from various member states, and delegates representing the ECO Secretariat alongside its subsidiary bodies.

Ahead of the main ministerial sessions, senior officials representing the member countries will convene to evaluate ongoing organizational activities and programs. This preliminary gathering will also assess the performance of subsidiary bodies while finalizing the official agenda and draft outcome documents for the ministers to review. The meetings are set to address multilateral coordination and strategic priorities within the bloc.

Serving as the chair of the ECO for the 2006-2027 term, Pakistan intends to advance organizational goals under the guiding slogan 'Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO'. The nation's leadership focus aims to prioritize reinforced regional connectivity and deepen integration to foster collaborative paths toward sustainable development and prosperity. This responsibility highlights the country's objective to reinvigorate platforms for economic dialogue and cooperation.

Furthermore, the chairmanship offers Pakistan a strategic platform to establish itself as a prominent regional connectivity center, a logistics supply chain facilitator, and a trade agenda-setter. These initiatives are intended to unlock broader economic capabilities across member states. Ultimately, the framework seeks to ensure that collaborative regional advantages translate into tangible living standard improvements for the populations residing within the ECO region.

stories.title: Usman Century Powers Pakistan Against India in U19 Asia Cup Final
stories.summary:
Pakistan Under-19 reached a total of 275 for three in 40.2 overs against India during the Asian Cricket Council Under-19 Asia Cup final on Saturday. The championship match is taking place at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground located in Oman. Opening batsman Usman Khan anchored the innings by hitting his second tournament century, scoring 107 runs from 111 balls with the help of 11 boundaries and three sixes.

Usman formed an initial 62-run partnership for the first wicket alongside Hayam Khan, who contributed 21 runs before being dismissed by bowler Kavya Paresh Patel. Following that breakthrough, Abdul Qadir entered the crease to score an explosive 80 runs off 54 deliveries, which featured eight sixes and three fours. Together, Usman and Qadir forged a crucial 135-run partnership for the second wicket.

Bowler Kavya Paresh Patel claimed two wickets by removing both opening batsmen, while teammate Arjun Rajput accounted for the wicket of Abdul Qadir, leaving Pakistan positioned at 240 for three. Following these dismissals, team captain Farhan Yousaf remained undefeated on 48 runs from 47 balls. He was joined at the crease by Ahmed Hussain, who was not out on eight runs as the innings progressed.

India has yet to commence its run chase in the title clash as Pakistan attempts to establish a formidable target. The tournament final highlights a high-stakes encounter between the two cricketing rivals in the youth competition, with fans eagerly watching the outcome of the title match in Oman.

stories.title: ایران کا آبنائے ہرمز میں اجازت کے بغیر گزرنے والے تین آئل ٹینکرز بارودی سرنگوں سے ٹکرانے کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
ایران کی بحریہ اور پاسدارانِ انقلاب نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ آبنائے ہرمز میں تین آئل ٹینکرز بارودی سرنگوں سے ٹکرا گئے ہیں جس کے نتیجے میں ان جہازوں میں آگ بھڑک اٹھی ہے۔ ایرانی حکام کے مطابق یہ تمام جہاز مبینہ طور پر بغیر کسی اجازت کے آبنائے ہرمز سے گزرنے کی کوشش کر رہے تھے۔

خبر رساں ادارے اے ایف پی کے مطابق پاسدارانِ انقلاب کی بحریہ کی جانب سے جاری کردہ بیان میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ ان میں سے دو آئل ٹینکروں نے اپنے ریڈار اور مقام کی نشاندہی کرنے والے نظام بند کر رکھے تھے۔ یہ دونوں جہاز خفیہ طریقے سے اور غیر مجاز راستے سے آبنائے ہرمز کو عبور کرنے کی کوشش میں بارودی سرنگ سے ٹکرا گئے اور دھماکے کے بعد آگ کی لپیٹ میں آ گئے۔

دوسری جانب ایران کی روایتی بحریہ نے اپنے ایک الگ بیان میں انکشاف کیا ہے کہ ایک اور آئل ٹینکر آبنائے ہرمز کے مشرق میں واقع غیر محفوظ اور ممنوعہ قرار دیے گئے علاقے سے گزر رہا تھا۔ اس تیسرے جہاز کے بھی ٹریکنگ اور شناختی نظام بند تھے اور بارودی سرنگ سے ٹکرانے کے بعد آگ کی زد میں آنے کے باعث اسے اپنا سفر روکنا پڑا۔

واضح رہے کہ فروری میں امریکا کے ساتھ جنگ شروع ہونے کے بعد سے تہران نے آبنائے ہرمز سے گزرنے والے جہازوں کے لیے اپنی اجازت کو لازمی قرار دے رکھا ہے اور اس کا مؤقف ہے کہ غیر مجاز گزرنے والوں کے خلاف کارروائی کی جاسکتی ہے۔ تاہم، ایرانی حکام کے ان دعوؤں کی تاحال کسی بھی آزاد ذرائع سے تصدیق نہیں ہو سکی ہے اور نہ ہی متاثرہ ٹینکروں کے نام، عملے کی حالت یا جانی نقصان سے متعلق کوئی تفصیلات جاری کی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: فلائی جناح کا پہلا برانڈ نیا ایئربس اے 320 نیو طیارہ فرانس سے کراچی پہنچ گیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان کی نجی ایئرلائن فلائی جناح کا بالکل نیا ایئربس اے 320 نیو طیارہ فرانس کے شہر ٹولوز سے پرواز کر کے کراچی ایئرپورٹ پہنچ گیا۔ کراچی لینڈنگ کے بعد پاکستان ایئرپورٹس اتھارٹی کی جانب سے اس طیارے کو روایتی واٹر سیلوٹ پیش کیا گیا۔

یہ برانڈ نیو طیارہ پاکستانی رجسٹریشن نمبر AP-BQA کے ساتھ ایئربس کے ہیڈکوارٹرز سے فیری فلائٹ کے ذریعے پاکستان لایا گیا۔ اس کا مینوفیکچرر سیریل نمبر 13606 ہے اور اس میں CFM LEAP-1A26 انجن نصب کیے گئے ہیں۔ یہ کسی بھی نجی پاکستانی ایئرلائن کے بیڑے میں شامل ہونے والا پہلا بالکل نیا طیارہ ہے۔

طیارے نے دو نومبر کو ٹولوز میں اپنی پہلی کامیاب آزمائشی پرواز مکمل کی تھی جو دو گھنٹے اور دو منٹ تک جاری رہی تھی۔ تمام تکنیکی مراحل طے کرنے کے بعد دس نومبر کو اسے بیرون ملک سے پاکستان منتقلی کے لیے مکمل طور پر تیار کر لیا گیا تھا۔

فلائی جناح کے اس نئے طیارے کی ایک اہم خصوصیت یہ ہے کہ یہ پچھلے ماڈلز کے مقابلے میں فی نشست کم از کم بیس فیصد کم ایندھن استعمال کرتا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ جدید ریڈارز کی تنصیب کی بدولت اس طیارے کی پرواز کی حد تین ہزار چار سو ناٹیکل میل تک پہنچ جاتی ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Demands Halt to Gulf Attacks and Urges Regional De-escalation at UN
stories.summary:
Pakistan has called for an immediate cessation of military provocations and attacks targeting Gulf states, emphasizing the critical need to protect civilians, commercial shipping, and regional stability. Speaking at a United Nations Security Council session on Friday, Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, expressed grave concern over rising maritime threats and regional tensions. He acknowledged briefings provided by the Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary-General and Assistant Secretary-General Khalid Khiari, highlighting the severe implications of ongoing escalation for regional security.

Ambassador Shah underlined the vital role that regional waterways play in sustaining international commerce and delivering essential supplies of energy and other commodities. He noted that Pakistan shares deep-rooted historical, religious, and people-to-people ties with Gulf nations, making their security and prosperity profoundly important. Condemning all hostile actions against Gulf Cooperation Council members, Shah explicitly denounced attacks by the Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia, including threats to civilian infrastructure and merchant vessels.

Highlighting the dangers posed to seafarers and navigational freedoms, Shah pointed out that disruptions in key maritime chokepoints like Bab al-Mandab and the Strait of Hormuz jeopardize regional stability, drive up energy costs, and stoke fears of global food insecurity. He stated that the Strait of Hormuz is indispensable, handling roughly one-third of globally traded crude oil and a large share of the global fertilizer trade. Consequently, he advocated for the unhindered passage of commercial shipping and the protection of vessel crews.

Concluding his address, Shah urged the international community to address the root causes of conflict by fostering a regional framework rooted in common security, mutual prosperity, and peaceful coexistence. He stressed that diplomacy and dialogue must prevail, urging the UN Security Council to unite in demanding an end to unlawful attacks and military provocations. Pakistan reaffirmed its commitment to collaborating with international partners to ensure lasting peace, maritime security, and stability throughout the region.

stories.title: عالمی فوجداری عدالت نے افغانستان میں امریکی افواج کے مبینہ جرائم کی تحقیقات بند کر دیں
stories.summary:
عالمی فوجداری عدالت (آئی سی سی) نے افغانستان میں امریکی فوجیوں اور خفیہ اداروں کے اہلکاروں پر عائد مبینہ جنگی جرائم کی پرانی تحقیقات کا ریکارڈ باضابطہ طور پر بند کرنے کا حکم دے دیا ہے۔ دی ہیگ میں قائم اس عدالت کے ججوں کا کہنا ہے کہ اب عدالت کی تمام تر توجہ افغانستان میں سنہ دو ہزار اکیس کے بعد طالبان کی جانب سے کیے جانے والے مبینہ جرائم کی تحقیقات پر مرکوز ہوگی۔

خبر رساں اداروں رائٹرز اور ایسوسی ایٹڈ پریس کے مطابق عدالت کے ججوں نے مؤقف اپنایا ہے کہ استغاثہ یہ ثابت کرنے میں مکمل طور پر ناکام رہا ہے کہ وہ طالبان سے متعلق الگ تحقیقات کے ساتھ ساتھ افغانستان میں دیگر مبینہ جرائم کی مزید مؤثر تفتیش اور قانونی کارروائی بھی جاری رکھ سکتا ہے۔

عدالت نے اپنے فیصلے میں واضح طور پر اس بات کا حوالہ دیا کہ تحقیقات کے لیے ضروری شواہد اکٹھے کرنے اور مجموعی طور پر تفتیشی سرگرمیاں جاری رکھنے میں شدید قانونی اور عملی مشکلات کا سامنا تھا۔ انھی عملی رکاوٹوں کے پیش نظر سابقہ امریکی جرائم سے متعلق اس پرانے کیس کو اب ختم کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے۔

عالمی فوجداری عدالت کے اس اقدام کا مقصد وسائل کو محدود کرنا اور موجودہ حالات کے مطابق نئی ترجیحات بالخصوص طالبان کے دور میں ہونے والے مبینہ جرائم پر اپنی قانونی توجہ مرکوز کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: عوام کا حکومت سے پاکستان کو عالمی معدنی قوت بنانے کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
عوام نے حکومت سے مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ ملک کے معدنی ذخائر کو مکمل طور پر بروئے کار لایا جائے تاکہ پاکستان کو ایک عالمی معدنی قوت بنایا جا سکے۔ شہریوں کا کہنا ہے کہ معاشی خود انحصاری کے حصول کی خاطر ہنگامی بنیادوں پر عملی اقدامات کرنے کی اشد ضرورت ہے۔

اس ضمن میں فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر کی جانب سے معیشت کو مستحکم کرنے اور معدنی شعبے کی جانب غیر ملکی سرمایہ کاری کھینچنے کی کوششوں کو سراہا گیا ہے۔ شہریوں کے مطابق پاکستان منرلز انویسٹمنٹ فورم میں ساٹھ سے زائد ممالک کی شرکت سے اس بات کا ثبوت ملتا ہے کہ بین الاقوامی سرمایہ کار ملک کے معدنی ذخائر میں گہری دلچسپی رکھتے ہیں۔

بلوچستان اور خیبرپختونخوا کے علاقوں میں موجود سونے اور تانبے کے ذخائر کو جدید ترین ٹیکنالوجی کی مدد سے استعمال کر کے ملکی معیشت کو سہارا دیا جا سکتا ہے۔ عوام کا ماننا ہے کہ حکومت کی بہتر پالیسیوں اور ان معدنی منصوبوں کے باعث مقامی سطح پر روزگار کے نئے مواقع سامنے آئیں گے۔

عالم اسلام کی معدنی دولت سے مالامال واحد قوت ہونے کی حیثیت سے، جدید ٹیکنالوجی اور غیر ملکی سرمایہ کاری کا درست استعمال ملکی معیشت کو خود کفیل بنا سکتا ہے۔ اس کے نتیجے میں عوام کی خوشحالی کے نئے راستے کھلیں گے، جس کے لیے حکومت کو فوری اور عملی اقدامات اٹھانے ہوں گے۔

stories.title: وسیم اکرم اور محمد حفیظ کا سینڈ پیپر تنازع پر اظہارِ خیال
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے سابق کپتان اور لیجنڈری فاسٹ بولر وسیم اکرم نے بال ٹیمپرنگ کے سینڈ پیپر تنازع پر اپنی خاموشی ختم کرتے ہوئے پیٹ کمنز کے مؤقف پر شکوک کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ تجربہ کار بولرز کے لیے یہ پہچاننا بالکل مشکل نہیں ہوتا کہ گیند پر نشانات قدرتی ہیں یا انہیں سینڈ پیپر کے ذریعے نقصان پہنچایا گیا ہے۔

سوشل میڈیا پر جاری کردہ ایک ویڈیو میں وسیم اکرم نے وضاحت کی کہ معمول کے حالات میں گیند پر بننے والے نشانات اور سینڈ پیپر کے ذریعے لگائی جانے والی خراشوں میں بہت واضح فرق ہوتا ہے۔ انہوں نے کرکٹ کے شائقین کو یہ مشورہ بھی دیا کہ وہ خود ایک نئی گیند اور سینڈ پیپر کی مدد سے اس فرق کا مشاہدہ کر سکتے ہیں۔

وسیم اکرم نے اس امر کو واضح کیا کہ ان کا مقصد کسی بھی فریق کی حمایت یا مخالفت کرنا نہیں ہے، بلکہ آسٹریلوی کرکٹ کی بنیادی پہچان دیانت داری اور سخت مسابقت پر مبنی ہے۔

دوسری جانب پاکستان کے ایک اور سابق کرکٹر محمد حفیظ نے بھی سوشل میڈیا کے ذریعے سینڈ پیپر کے معاملے پر پیٹ کمنز کے مؤقف کو تنقید کا نشانہ بنایا۔ انہوں نے پیٹ کمنز کے بیان کو بے معنی قرار دیتے ہوئے اس پر کڑے سوالات اٹھائے ہیں۔

stories.title: جو بائیڈن کا نیتن یاہو پر غزہ جنگ سے متعلق وعدہ خلافی کا الزام
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے سابق صدر جو بائیڈن نے اپنی آنے والی کتاب میں انکشاف کیا ہے کہ اسرائیلی وزیراعظم بنیامین نیتن یاہو نے غزہ جنگ کے دوران شہریوں کی ہلاکتیں کم کرنے کے بار بار کیے گئے وعدوں کی خلاف ورزی کی۔ ان کی 480 صفحات پر مشتمل یادداشتوں پر مبنی کتاب سترہ نومبر کو شائع ہونے والی ہے۔

بائیڈن کے مطابق انہوں نے اسرائیلی قیادت پر زور دیا تھا کہ فوجی کارروائیوں کے دوران عام شہریوں کی جانوں کے تحفظ کے لیے احتیاطی تدابیر اختیار کی جائیں۔ نیتن یاہو نجی ملاقاتوں اور ٹیلی فونک گفتگو میں امریکی مطالبات تسلیم کرنے کی یقین دہانی کراتے تھے لیکن اس کے باوجود ایسی فوجی کارروائیاں جاری رہتی تھیں جن میں فلسطینی شہری ہلاک ہوتے تھے۔

سابق امریکی صدر نے لکھا کہ اسرائیلی وزیراعظم خود بھی اس بات کو تسلیم کرتے تھے کہ فلسطینی شہریوں کی بڑھتی ہوئی اموات اسرائیل کی عالمی ساکھ اور جنگ کے لیے امریکی حمایت کو نقصان پہنچا رہی ہیں۔ اس کے باوجود زمینی حقائق میں کوئی تبدیلی نہیں آئی اور کارروائیاں جاری رہیں۔

یہ انکشافات ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئے ہیں جب کتاب کے اقتباسات امریکی میڈیا پر جاری کیے گئے ہیں۔ اس کتاب میں صدر بائیڈن کے دورِ حکومت کے دوران پیش آنے والے اہم بین الاقوامی امور اور سفارتی چیلنجز پر تفصیلی روشنی ڈالی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Fiscal Surplus Drops 40 Percent as Revenues and Provincial Surpluses Fall
stories.summary:
Pakistan's fiscal buffers experienced a downturn in the first quarter of the current fiscal year, as the overall fiscal surplus fell by 40 percent to Rs1.273 trillion compared to Rs2.12 trillion during the same period last year, according to Ministry of Finance data. Measured as a share of GDP, the surplus dropped to 0.9pc from 1.7pc. The primary surplus also narrowed to 2.1pc of GDP, or Rs2.97 trillion, down 15pc from Rs3.5 trillion a year earlier, despite ongoing expenditure controls and subsidy reductions.

Total revenue declined as a share of GDP to 4.2pc from 4.9pc, and fell in absolute terms to Rs6.004 trillion from Rs6.2 trillion. The reduction was largely driven by a drop in non-tax revenue, which fell to Rs2.6 trillion from Rs3.046 trillion due to lower State Bank profits of Rs1.933 trillion compared to Rs2.43 trillion previously. Meanwhile, tax revenue increased in absolute terms to Rs3.387 trillion from Rs3.153 trillion, though its GDP ratio slipped to 2.4pc. On the expenditure side, total spending rose by 16pc to Rs4.73 trillion. Interest payments jumped over 23pc to Rs1.7 trillion, becoming a major expenditure driver, while subsidies were curtailed to Rs84.6 billion.

Provincial cash surpluses also contracted by 23pc to Rs600 billion. Punjab's surplus fell to Rs333 billion and Sindh's dropped to Rs181 billion, whereas Khyber Pakhtunkhwa increased its surplus to Rs102 billion. Balochistan recorded a deficit of Rs16 billion, contrasting with a surplus previously. Discrepancies of Rs60 billion in provincial accounts and Rs98 billion federally were attributed to reporting lags, delayed payments, and book adjustments.

This fiscal tightening matters because it illustrates weakening economic buffers amid declining revenue-to-GDP ratios and rising debt-servicing obligations. Monitoring these figures provides key insights into the government's macroeconomic stability, budgetary execution, and financial performance during the first quarter.

stories.title: Punjab Agriculture Department Reports Rise in Wheat Cultivation and Sowing Area
stories.summary:
The Punjab Agriculture Department announced that it has successfully achieved over 50 percent of the provincial wheat cultivation target for the current season. Officials shared these updates during a briefing held in Lahore on Friday for Agriculture Minister Ashiq Kirmani, highlighting that the total cultivated area for wheat has expanded by 7.7 percent compared to the same period in the previous year. Furthermore, the department reported that 51 percent of the total cultivated area utilized line sowing methods, while the adoption rate of certified seeds reached 44 percent.

Minister Kirmani instructed field formations to actively assist farmers throughout the entire wheat cultivation campaign to guarantee that official targets are met successfully. He also emphasized the necessity of ensuring that quality seeds and fertilizers remain accessible to farmers at officially notified prices. In addition to wheat cultivation, the high-level meeting included a review of paddy harvesting, precautions against crop residue burning, and various initiatives tied to the ongoing smog control program.

Discussions during the briefing also covered financial support programs for farmers, noting that the fifth phase of the Kissan Card scheme has approved agricultural loans totaling Rs100 billion for one million farmers. Out of this total, 818,000 farmers have already received credit facilities, with Rs26 billion in loans having been utilized so far. Additionally, the meeting reviewed progress on the Green Tractor Programme, stating that 1,840 tractors were distributed under the fourth phase, while 9,500 locally manufactured and imported tractors are planned for the fifth phase, following the receipt of 305,000 applications and the completion of 188,000 verifications.

stories.title: Pakistan Federal Government Domestic Debt Decreases to Rs57.7 Trillion
stories.summary:
The federal government of Pakistan experienced a significant decrease in its domestic debt during the first quarter of the 2026-27 fiscal year, marking a reversal from the rising trend seen in the preceding year. According to the latest data released by the State Bank of Pakistan, the total domestic debt dropped to Rs57.757 trillion by September 30, falling from Rs59.393 trillion recorded on June 30. This represents a reduction of Rs1.636 trillion over the single quarter, aligning with broader efforts by the government to tighten the fiscal deficit under an ongoing International Monetary Fund program.

Planning, Development and Special Initiative Minister Ahsan Iqbal recently noted that the fiscal deficit narrowed to 2.6 percent of the Gross Domestic Product in the 2025-26 fiscal year, improving from 5.4 percent in the previous fiscal year and marking the lowest deficit recorded in two decades. Accompanying this reduction, State Bank data revealed a sharp increase in the government's net retirement of scheduled-bank debt, which climbed to Rs1.847 trillion between July and October of the 2027 fiscal year, compared to just Rs45 billion during the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, demonstrating that debt repayments heavily outpaced new borrowing.

Borrowing trends also shifted across various debt instruments during the period. Outstanding amounts through long-term Pakistan Investment Bonds declined by Rs1.756 trillion to settle at Rs33.543 trillion at the close of the first quarter, counteracting prior trends as the government continued to prioritize long-term borrowing over short-term obligations. Concurrently, short-term borrowing via Treasury bills decreased by Rs1.163 trillion to reach Rs9.640 trillion. Conversely, external debt rose in rupee terms from Rs24.2 trillion on June 30 to Rs24.9 trillion on September 30, reflecting an increase of Rs700 billion.

stories.title: Global Oil Supplies Projected to Outpace Demand in Fourth Quarter
stories.summary:
Global oil supplies are anticipated to surpass demand during the fourth quarter of the year, driven by a surge in Gulf exports that created a market surplus in October for the first time since the outbreak of the war in Iran. The International Energy Agency announced these findings in its monthly report released from Paris on Friday, highlighting a notable shift in market dynamics despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and security challenges in vital shipping lanes.

The Paris-based energy agency noted that ongoing attacks on commercial tankers attempting to navigate through the Strait of Hormuz have persisted. Nevertheless, Gulf shipments managed to climb to 18.4 million barrels per day. Despite this recovery in export volumes, the agency pointed out that shipment levels remain 26 percent below where they stood prior to the onset of the war in Iran.

Summarizing the current market conditions, the International Energy Agency stated that the global oil market is beginning to exhibit tentative signs of rebalancing. The emergence of a surplus in October marks a significant turning point, as global oil supplies have finally overtaken total demand following months of disruption and constrained production caused by regional conflict.

stories.title: Sindh Government Plans Gradual Shift to Electric Vehicles for Departments
stories.summary:
The Sindh provincial government has formally decided to progressively transition away from conventional petrol-powered vehicles in favor of electric vehicles across all government departments. The strategic initiative is designed to curb public expenditures, conserve fuel resources, and mitigate urban environmental pollution. The decision was finalized during a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Austerity, which was presided over by Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon and attended by Local Government Minister Syed Nasir Hussain Shah.

During the session, officials evaluated measures to reduce official expenditures, lower fuel consumption, and assess the specific transport needs of various provincial institutions. A formal press statement confirmed that the committee approved the procurement of new vehicles designated for the home department, the Anti-Corruption Establishment, and the universities and boards department. Moving forward, the administration has agreed to prioritize electric vehicles in all future government purchases to systematically replace conventional fleets with environmentally friendly technology.

Senior Minister Memon, who also oversees the information, transport, and mass transit portfolios, emphasized that conserving official resources remains a core priority for the provincial administration. He reiterated that the administration aims to transition the entire official vehicle network toward green technology to lessen dependence on traditional fuels and lower daily departmental expenses. Echoing these remarks, Local Government Minister Shah highlighted that vehicle emissions severely degrade urban air quality, adding that local government institutions will similarly prioritize electric mobility moving forward.

stories.title: EU Vows to Defend Climate Science Amid Standoff at COP31 Talks
stories.summary:
At the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) held at the Antalya Expo Centre in Turkiye, a fierce dispute over the timing of future Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) reports has complicated negotiations. The European Union announced on Friday that it would fight for science after accusing certain nations of attempting to undermine the world's leading global warming authority. A coalition of European, African, and Pacific countries wants the upcoming IPCC assessments published in time to inform a critical global carbon-cutting stocktake at the 2028 climate summit.

Conversely, a smaller faction of nations, including China, India, and Saudi Arabia, is pushing to delay the seventh assessment report until 2029. The disagreement previously caused the IPCC to suspend its last meeting. Senior EU climate official Diana Acconcia criticized the polarized environment, stating that some parties wish to avoid mandatory climate actions. United Nations Secretary General Antonio Guterres praised the IPCC's work and endorsed releasing the next report ahead of the 2028 stocktake. IPCC chairman Jim Skea warned delegates on the opening day of COP31 that the current impasse poses reputational risks and operational challenges for the organization.

Climate scientist and previous IPCC author Pierre Friedlingstein noted that policy decisions benefit most from up-to-date science rather than seven-year-old data, though updated figures may highlight the gap between current action and necessary warming limits. Negotiators in Antalya suggest that consensus among the nearly 200 participating nations will be difficult to reach before the summit concludes. However, there remains a concerted push among observers and delegates to explicitly recognize the central role of IPCC science in any final COP31 agreement.

stories.title: European Leaders Reject Security Architecture Discussions in Russia Peace Talks
stories.summary:
European leaders asserted on Friday during an EU summit in Dublin that the continent's security structure should not be up for negotiation in any future Ukraine-Russia peace talks. The Kremlin had previously indicated openness to European participation if European nations demonstrated a readiness to contribute to the peace process. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz dismissed Moscow's comments, stating that Europe and the United States share a unified stance that there will be no discussions about Ukraine without Ukraine, and no discussions about Europe without Europe. Merz added that a European security architecture already exists.

Russian officials have consistently sought a broad agreement concerning Europe's security framework prior to addressing specific war details, mirroring pre-invasion demands made in 2022 regarding NATO force withdrawals. During recent discussions in Moscow, US negotiator Jared Kushner informed officials that he had initiated talks with European partners regarding the continent's security architecture. Meanwhile, EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned that Russian calls for such discussions risk distracting from the urgent need for a ceasefire, while Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs labeled the proposals a trap. On Thursday, representatives from 40 European countries signed a declaration in Dublin stipulating that any matters impacting European security must involve direct European participation.

While EU leaders generally agreed on the necessity of speaking with one voice, they did not designate a single individual to represent the bloc. Merz noted that institutional representation includes figures like Kaja Kallas alongside the effective E3 format comprising France, Germany, and the UK, as well as Italy and Poland. Representatives from Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and the EU recently attended Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, where minor progress was noted without any definitive breakthroughs. Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson emphasized that Britain, as a leading military power, must be included in future talks alongside the aforementioned nations and EU institutions.

stories.title: اسلام آباد کے مارگلہ ڈائیلاگ میں بھارت کی خارجہ پالیسی پر کڑی تنقید
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہونے والے مارگلہ ڈائیلاگ کے دوران بھارت کی داخلی اور خارجہ پالیسیوں کو شدید تنقید کا نشانہ بنایا گیا۔ تقریب میں اظہار خیال کرتے ہوئے بھارتی دفاعی تجزیہ کار پروین سواہنے نے کہا کہ بھارت کی خارجہ پالیسی مکمل طور پر ناکام ہو چکی ہے جس کا اسٹریٹجک سطح پر دوبارہ جائزہ لینا ناگزیر ہے۔

تجزیہ کار نے بتایا کہ بھارت اور بھوٹان کے علاوہ پاکستان سمیت جنوبی ایشیا کے تمام ممالک چین کے بیلٹ اینڈ روڈ انیشی ایٹو منصوبے میں شامل ہو چکے ہیں۔ خطے کے اکثر ممالک کا اس بڑے معاشی منصوبے کا حصہ بننا بھارتی سفارتکاری کی بڑی نا کامی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

تقریب میں اس امر پر بھی زور دیا گیا کہ پاکستان نے ہمیشہ خطے میں بھارت کے تسلط پسندانہ رویے کو مسترد کیا ہے اور اپنے اصولوں پر ڈٹ کر قائم رہا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا کی بدلتی ہوئی جیو پولیٹیکل صورتحال میں پاکستان کا مؤقف خطے کے امن و استحکام کے لیے اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

مارگلہ ڈائیلاگ جیسے بین الاقوامی فورمز پر خطے کے سیکیورٹی امور، معاشی چیلنجز اور دو طرفہ تعلقات پر کھل کر بحث کی جاتی ہے جہاں خطے کے نامور ماہرین اور تجزیہ کار اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کرتے ہیں۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Welcomes Ivanhoe Mines' Investment Interest
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met with Robert Friedland, the founder and executive co-chairman of Canadian mining company Ivanhoe Mines, in Islamabad on Friday. During the discussion, Sharif offered government support to the firm for exploring investment opportunities within Pakistan's copper, gold, and critical minerals sectors. He welcomed the company's interest in collaborating with local partners.

Sharif highlighted that Pakistan holds substantial reserves of copper, gold, and other critical minerals, noting that international partnerships can effectively develop the sector and boost economic growth. He assured that the administration is committed to facilitating foreign investment, pointing out that the Special Investment Facilitation Council will provide direct support to the company's investment plans.

Additionally, the prime minister expressed approval of the memorandums of understanding exchanged during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum, calling them a positive step toward driving investment into the mining industry. Friedland expressed strong confidence in the mineral potential of Pakistan.

Furthermore, the visiting delegation commended the ongoing efforts of the government to promote economic reforms and foster regional stability. This engagement underscores Islamabad's broader efforts to attract international mining companies and transform its untapped mineral resources into a vital driver of national economic development.

stories.title: Prime Minister Urges Global Miners to Invest in Local Processing
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif urged international mining companies to invest in local mineral processing, refining, and manufacturing facilities at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad on Friday. Emphasizing an integrated industrial base, he reiterated a policy to end the export of raw minerals, instructing investors to mine, process, and manufacture within the country before exporting finished products globally. He highlighted that major ventures like the RekoDiq project in Balochistan should serve as foundations for downstream industries such as refineries, smelters, and cable factories to generate employment and expand manufacturing capacity.

Addressing investor concerns, Sharif acknowledged that security challenges, infrastructure gaps, and bureaucratic delays remain critical hurdles. He promised a level playing field, transparent rules, consistent policies, and swift decision-making, offering to personally intervene in cases held up by administrative procedures. He also noted that the newly established National Mineral Data Cell and digitized geological records will help investors easily assess mineral potential prior to committing funds.

To address safety concerns, Sharif assured that federal and provincial authorities will cooperate to protect company personnel, assets, and supply routes, declaring that safeguarding investments is a fundamental government responsibility. He also emphasized the necessity of reliable infrastructure—including electricity, water, roads, and railways—to support large-scale mining operations and transport finished products efficiently.

Finally, Sharif stressed that mineral development must adhere to international environmental standards to protect water resources and ensure worker health and safety. He underscored that project success depends on local community cooperation, urging companies to establish vocational training centers, transfer technology, and improve local education, healthcare, and access to clean drinking water. The two-day forum brought together government officials and international executives to unlock the economic potential of Pakistan's mineral reserves.

stories.title: Mari Energies Announces New Copper-Gold Discovery in Balochistan
stories.summary:
Faheem Haider, Managing Director and CEO of Mari Energies Limited, announced a significant copper-gold discovery at the East SiahDiq target in District Chagai, Balochistan, on Friday. Speaking at the Pakistan Mineral Investment Forum 2026, Haider stated that the discovery was made by Mari Minerals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Mari Energies. The site lies approximately 50 kilometres east of the RekoDiq copper-gold development project and 25 kilometres northwest of Nokkundi in the Koh-i-Sultan area, where Mari Minerals holds multiple exploration licences.

Exploration at the site involved completing roughly 25,000 metres of drilling across two phases, with drill holes extending to a depth of 500 metres. This drilling successfully identified porphyry copper-style mineralisation beneath about 100 metres of overburden across an area of approximately 1.4 square kilometres. Haider described the find as a crucial milestone that strengthens confidence in the geological potential of the Chagai region, noting that future efforts will focus on technical studies to determine the scale and development potential of the discovery.

Initial drilling results support the identification of a new porphyry copper discovery, while laboratory analysis for samples from the second phase is currently underway and expected to be completed in the first quarter of 2027. SGS Pakistan handled sample preparation and assaying under a quality assurance program, with technical information reviewed by Dr. John Mortimer of JM Geoscience Pty Ltd.

Because preliminary drilling indicates mineralisation may extend deeper, upcoming exploration phases will test potentials down to 1,000 metres alongside assessing lateral extents. An initial geological model and resource estimate will be developed using data from both completed phases. Additional technical studies, metallurgical testing, and resource estimations are required to confirm the discovery's economic significance, while Mari Energies has formally notified the Pakistan Stock Exchange of the finding.

stories.title: Army Chief Assures Complete Security for Pakistan's Mining Ecosystem
stories.summary:
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces, stated on Friday that all necessary measures are being taken to secure the entire mining ecosystem in Pakistan. Speaking at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad, he assured attendees that mines, miners, investments, industries, projects, and all associated personnel will receive adequate protection. He reaffirmed the country's commitment to providing a secure and competitive environment for long-term mineral investments.

Munir emphasized that Pakistan's overarching ambition is to develop the complete value chain rather than merely exporting raw materials. He explained that the national objective encompasses extraction, refining, and manufacturing, aiming to foster long-term partnerships that generate sustainable economic value for both Pakistan and international investors. He noted that the country seeks a transition from potential to productivity, commitments to implementation, and raw exports to value-added growth.

Furthermore, the Chief of Defence Forces stressed that mineral development must provide tangible benefits to the residents of resource-rich regions, ensuring that local populations see concrete improvements in their daily lives. He praised the hardworking and courageous nature of the Pakistani people, describing them as a primary source of strength and determination.

Munir concluded by noting that while the nation's natural resources provide distinct opportunities, its people possess the necessary drive to turn national aspirations into reality. His remarks underscored the military's supportive role in safeguarding foreign and domestic economic initiatives within the country's expanding mineral sector.

stories.title: Federal Board of Revenue Restructures Tax Departments in Surprise Move
stories.summary:
In Islamabad, the Federal Board of Revenue implemented major organizational changes late Friday night by separating the sales tax, federal excise duty, and income tax departments. This shift involves transferring 54 Inland Revenue officials, ranging from BS-17 to BS-21, to a newly established post titled Member, Sales Tax & FED (Technical). Dr. Muhammad Sarmad Qureshi, an Inland Revenue Service officer in BS-21, has been designated to fill this new role.
